不錯的放置類遊戲，畫風和繪製很舒服舒服，遊戲音樂和音效也非常好，也有不少細緻的場景互動。

按鍵交互的方式有點怪，鍵位設置也不算自由，也不能只用鼠標就完成操作。

地圖的路線比較散亂，人物對障礙物的避讓也很不智能，部分地方的路線很低效，要繞一大段路才可以去到。

戶型不算多，部分戶型不算合理，佈置出來的佈局很怪，部分情況會和室內設計的思路有挺大的衝突。

核心玩法有點不足，很多時會變成在街上重複地和各種場景小物件交互而沒有太多去佈置房間。

終盤內容單調，後期的支線任務很重複，收益很低，結合遊戲的物品管理和倉存系統，沒有讓人認真完成的動力。通關後獲得的能力加成也非常雞肋，對遊玩幾乎不會造成什麼實質性的幫助。

然後非常重要的一個缺點是物件管理非常非常混亂！！場景中物件沒有名稱顯示，而在倉庫和圖鑒頁面里物件排序和分類邏輯也非常混亂。
有庫存數量設計，平時將物件取出或放回倉庫也會影響物件排序，倉庫的查找功能也不太好用，庫存歸零會影響任務中物件的顯示和使用？！
基本上大部分精力就花在物品的管理和補充中。而且倉庫補充也很麻煩，大部分物品只能步行到對應的商店購買，部分類型的物品似乎只有隨機開箱才能補充，很影響任務的執行和日常的管理。綜合商場中各店的位置也很散亂，購物選取時也有點不方便呀。

主題家具好像也並不齊全，似乎不一定能各自湊出一套主題家具的佈置。

正式版好像取消了一些EA版中有爭議性但比較有趣的劇情，不過這個相對不重要了。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

希望遊戲製作組在之後能完善物品管理和庫存系統，增加更多終盤內容。劇情結束後，除了涉及麻煩的物品管理且收益低的支線任務，基本只剩在遊戲裡點垃圾桶了。

This review hurts my heart, but I cannot recommend Whisper of the House in its current state. I have been looking forward to this game as a narrative game with a mechanic similar to Unpacking. However, the game actually plays half sandbox, half narrative. The narrative started off strong, but gets much weaker throughout the game - most of the npcs do not engage with you or have a further story after your initial task with them, and after the final narrative task, it feels like the game abruptly ends with no great conclusion. I like the idea of spooky elements in the game, but all it amounts to is clicking on certain items and there wasn't enough incentive for me to complete the museum. I'm also not a fan of the gacha/gambling system to unlock new furniture/items - I would rather be able to buy certain items with the vouchers.

I also played the game on my Steam Deck, which I don't recommend. It's technically playable but I got soft locked a few times and had some issues not unique to the deck - the search function for furniture is awful and the decoration wall/floor panel doesn't go away unless you leave the room and come back in.

I love the idea of this game, but it just feels unfinished and underdeveloped, and I sadly don't recommend it in its current state.

Если вы любите пиксель-арт, вам стоит купить эту игру! Стооолько красиво нарисованных деталей интерьера, которые ещё и супер легко покупаются и дают вам творить -- это с ума сойти. 

Нравится мистический подтекст, нагнетающий атмосферу, нравится городок, заказчики. По каким-то их вещам создаётся полный портрет человека. Да, у девушки магазин-пекарня, булочки, хлеб, но в спальне всякое для мистических ритуалов, а её парень вообще давным давно пропал... 

Ещё отмечу саунд-дизайн, ставишь стол из стекла -- слышишь, что это стекло. Духовка приятно гудит, стиральная машина неприятно шумит, бумага шелестит. 

В общем, это чудо, не знаю к чему всё идёт, но однозначно пройду игру до конца. Не хватает русского перевода, у меня скудные навыки владения английским, некоторые нюансы перевожу через переводчик, но глобально это не ощущается как проблема

总体来说很棒的游戏，但又有太多不足让我不吐为快。

作为休闲装修放置游戏，其宣传营造了一种非常温馨但又带有悬疑色彩的氛围，也确实都做到了，但！都不够！！！[b]游戏共16个主线委托[/b]，解锁结局解开所有悬疑真相需要[b]42个收集物[/b]，[b]流程4-8h不等[/b]（仅为主线时长，游戏重玩价值高）。在休闲装修与解密方面[b]（着重细心而轻智力）[/b]都令人满意，但在[b]温馨与悬疑方面非常欠缺[/b]（虽然是因为demo版太过惊悚而受反馈删减，但也因此太过欠缺），[b]所有不重复文本（包括物品的描述文本）保守估计不超过1万字，共有7个较为完整的小故事[/b]：
[list]
    [*]新邻居小妹露娜初来乍到，第一次委托家政工装修房间竟发现有个隐藏隔间，里面还有非常多杂物，是谁偷偷在这住着；
    [*]等待因法阵而失踪的炼金术师多年的面包店老板如今貌似已经失去了希望，但在万能的家政工细心的调查下，好像希望又重现了出来；
    [*]海边那间小屋的地下室好像藏着什么不属于地球的东西，是真的？是错觉？还是愿望的实体化；
    [*]镇上奇怪的天才发明家正在捣鼓时间传送门，好像是为了某个人。而现实不存在时间传送门，不要忽视身边重要的人而等到无可挽回了才追悔莫及；
    [*]神秘的墨镜帮委托整理了病房居然就送了个大别墅并把小猫送给万能家政工照料，貌似是被帮母选为了财产继承人了，但是为什么呢？好像我们都不得而知；
    [*]墓地常常有闹鬼的传言，但……好像真的有鬼欸；
    [*]呓语小镇，得名于镇上奇怪的报社，编者会在报纸上增添每日呓语小专栏，写着一些都市怪谈，镇上的人都不以为然，觉得他是个疯子，只有万能的家政工尝试去理解其中的奥秘，每发现类似的一个奥秘，博物馆顶端的数字就会相应地减1，当这个数字变为0时会发生什么呢？
    [*]除此之外还有零星几个小故事碎片散落在地图上等着万能家政工探索，这里就不过多赘述。
[/list]
万能的家政工慢慢地融入了这个小镇，委托人们对你的装修非常满意，或是送你家具，或是送你房子（好有钱啊）以表感谢。

[h2]装修委托[/h2]
游戏共1800+家具，制作组承诺后续会继续增加新家具。主线委托会给你指定的家具自由摆放（除乐器店），在我看来更像是新手教程，用指定家具引导玩家装修出符合主题且相对好看的房间。在完成16个主线委托后还会有每日委托，而每日委托提供了更多的样板房和装修需求，你可以发挥自己的主观能动性选择心仪的家具创造自己理解的中的理想房间，可重玩价值非常高，当然前提是要有足够的创意。

[h2]游戏对话与物品互动[/h2]
地图中能互动的元素很多，互动对话非常少，npc们的台词高度重复且谜语人，邻里温馨的味道瞬间少了一大截；相比之下物品的互动就比较丰富了：
[list]
    [*]看到那个垃圾桶了吗？翻它；
    [*]看到那个椅子了吗？坐它；
    [*]看到那个面包了吗？烤它；
    [*]看到那只猫了吗？摸它；
    [*]看到那个花盆了吗？种它；
    [*]看到那个画纸和画笔了吗？画它；
    [*]看到那个乐器了吗？奏它；
    [*]看到那个烟花了吗？放它；
    [*]看到那个飞天扫帚了吗？飞它……额，好像飞不起来。
[/list]
看到那个……算了不看了好多啊，各位万能的家政工们自行探索吧。其中又有很多可互动的物品没有实质作用，比如：
[list]
    [*]灶台能点火，也可以把锅放上去，但不能炒菜；
    [*]打蛋机可以启动，但不能打蛋做蛋糕；
    [*]炼金术师房间里的有些药瓶可以打开木塞，但无法做任何化学实验；
    [*]钓鱼竿能互动，但不能钓鱼；
    [*]海边的船能开，但不能坐上去。
[/list]
虽然对这个价位的国产独游来说已经很不错了，但还是想有点小小的希冀，希望其能成为中国特供家政工版星露谷物语，那就太酷了。

this game really helps me unwind and decompress so much after any stressful week, it's basically a free therapy taking on the immersive, somewhat wholesome missions on helping out the townsfolk arranging the furniture and redecorating their houses without any single deadlines. no time limit also means more encouragement for me to explore the buildings and houses i got assigned to.

for item collectors or perfectionists - eventhough there's only a tiny bit of gacha required to get all sets of furniture, it's so minimal that you're more than often finish your collection sooner than you think, and the game is quite generous in giving away "vouchers", which is basically the game's currency in order to purchase anything in-game. 80-90% of the game is the decoration gameplay itself, and the rest is optional content; either taking on additional, unlimited decoration missions (i.e creating your showroom from scratch with your own personal touches) and rolling for easy-to-get exclusive furnitures/buying the ones already available in the mall.

again, very much enjoying this game, and loving the cute, hopeful little plotlines among the townsfolk. it scratches the itch in my ADHD brain nicely. :)

其次，呓语小镇并非寻常小镇，里面布满了神秘学与邪教的线索，这一部分的内容几乎是开局就能让玩家意识到此游戏“来者不善”，不过游戏也给玩家提供了解决问题的方法，让你在面对客户可能面临的威胁时不必袖手旁观（当然你也可以故意这么做）。甚至你可以通过凭自己的努力解救客户消失的爱人，为游戏的可玩性增色不少。
同时游戏内小镇的规模也不算小，可交互选项颇多，甚至能在去任务的过程中顺手拧紧消防栓，或者听听镇民关于小镇的传闻~

I do wish that there was a bit more puzzles and anomalies to scratch your head on but it's not too bad. I also wished we did more 'cleaning up' rather than 'unpacking' but again, not too bad

Is it a perfect game? Not quite, no. But it is still an enjoyable experience and something I would still recommend friends to play when they have the time

I bought this game on a whim and I wasn't disappointed. There are a few things that could be expanded on as others have mentioned, but I'm looking forward to how the devs will add more, and they already have added new features since last I played.

Overall, the game looks a lot like Unpacking — the vibe is similar, but very cute. However, it is a bit short: only 5 to 6 hours. There are some fun side quests you can do, which make it a little longer to play. Overall, if you like cozy unpacking games, I 100% recommend this one.

不推荐。原因如下：
1.作为装修向游戏，物品画得很糊，不看描述根本不知道是什么
2.物品描述本来是锦上添花的设计，弥补了Unpacking时候不知道物品是什么的缺点，但问题是有些物品描述写的太怪了，狗子印花地垫的描述是：“进门的时候可以踩在狗子脸上”，狗狗相片的描述是“露娜真的很喜欢这两只犬科动物”（正常会叫狗狗犬科动物吗，主角也是人类吧），感觉像制作组在后期写描述的时候写得有点纯恨了，包括卷发棒的描述是“像短剑”，有点太小众了……
3.房间结构怪得一批，例如第一个房间的厨房柜子根本摆不齐，按理来说这种游戏应该是强迫症狂喜，但我只感到了狂躁……
4.机器人的设计是何意味？我在拿家具的时候老是会不小心点到移动机器人的选项。
5.有些家具设计得莫名其妙，卧室里出现Duang大一张餐桌，是希望我放哪
6.我不会退款因为我觉得能做游戏不容易，游戏是能看出是花了很多心思的，但是真心希望能做得更好

流程有点短，但是质量还可以。上部unpacking就玩得意犹未尽的，这部世界观和diy更广了一点，希望再多点内容，早日把dlc抬出来。

8h通关，玩了点委托（可惜房型都只有小单间）自家除了豪宅没装，顺手摸了个全成就。
主线主要延续unpacking式的打扫整理，同时也有一直给发空房子自由发挥，我就说我终于玩爽了。
背景设计意外很丰富，有些地方有一点点的怪诞。主要角色的地图都各自风格都挺结合故事情感，而且套了挺多类似童年回忆和送终关怀一类的打扫屋子，真是悲伤。。有许多可以触发的小机关，感觉像在玩玩具一样，喜欢这种充满玩心和悠闲感的设计，很推荐。

So, ich habe die Hauptstory nun durch.
Die Pixelgrafik ist niedlich und gefällt mir.
Auch ist es wirklich ein cozy Game, wo die Musik auch gut zu passt und die cozy Atmosphäre unterstützt.
Die Story selbst finde ich auch gut, und würde mich über DLCs freuen mit noch mehr Aufgaben.

Mit einem neuen Stadtteil, oder, wenn man das Vorhandene nimmt könnte man auch die Bücherei / das Kino usw. einbeziehen.

Was ich mir auch gut vorstellen könnte, ist, die Community mit einzubeziehen und sie kleine Geschichtchen und Personen kreieren zu lassen.

Insgesamt ein gelungenes Spiel, dass auch im Sandbox Modus einlädt, die eigenen Häuser / Wohnungen zu gestalten.
Man kann auch einfach zwischendrin zum Abschalten und "Runterkommen" das Spiel mal eine halbe Stunde spielen und das Spiel erreicht dieses ZIel.

Absolut empfehlenswert für Leute, die zwischendrin mal eine kurze Pause machen wollen, Pixelgrafik mögen und cozy Games lieben.

I LOVE WHISPER OF THE HOUSE!! It's a fun and relaxing game in which you just unpack people's houses and decorate them, similar to the game Unpacking! I thoroughly enjoyed this game. I bought a number of cleaning/unpacking style games recently, and Whisper of the House was one of them. Quite frankly I got so much more than I expected, with quirky characters, weird/funny happenings in town, and a wide variety of tasks, settings, scale, and so on. I like that it's not strictly one-dimensional in its tasks - you have cleaning, unboxing, organizing, staging, planting, puzzle solving, secret hunting and other things to keep you occupied. And at a visual level, I'm in love with the pixel design of the town and the settings. I'm a sucker for good pixel work, and this game has a fun, animated overworld and very detailed, charming designs for the rooms and objects.

My only "complaints" are that there isn't enough color customization in the furniture pieces; not enough items can be fully rotated (many are only 2 rotations); and I really wish the main character sprite had variety of skin tone for players!

Highly recommend if you're looking to scratch the cleaning/organizing sim itch with a little bit of fun "woah, what is happening?" story beats sprinkled in.

收纳游戏里我愿称之为画风的巅峰！而且没有很多硬性要求基本是想放哪放哪（除了有一关乐器店只能按照特定位置放），特别轻松解压，也很好拍照出片。缺点的话也有：
1，如果只推主线的话全流程7小时，不算很多，重复游玩方面我在狂玩了26小时之后也感觉也已经把喜欢的素材用尽了。我是折后43r入的，这个体量略微有一点小贵。只好期待一下持续更新
2，主线中的家具鼠标悬停有一句话的说明文案，很有意思，但只有部分有，也只有主线有。这个像素下还是挺需要这种说明的，不然各种小东西容易根本看不清是什么，还会像我一样把笔记本电脑当体重秤扔地上。期待文案补完
3，游戏内是真的有小镇地图的，买家具做主线都要跑到对应的建筑，相应的也会有反复跑图的时间。有些犄角旮旯会比较反逻辑，类似明明看见半个门但是过去了发现门是锁的过不去。

以上，也算鸡蛋挑骨头的缺点！呓语小镇真好玩，还可以摸猫，写完评价就准备再去装修一套。

Although still a short game, I found myself enjoying a ton of the features, from exploring a village, clearing it of anomalies and customizing houses with different themes! My only gripe would be the actual story, the game set a plot that the entire game revolved around, and yet its execution felt short. A big problem was that it was hyped up so much and when that expectation wasn't met, it becomes frustrating. The game was set up as if it had a conflict that can't be solved by simply clearing the appropriate amount of anomalies, the ending of the game felt like it shied away from anything distinct which made it disappointing. Whisper of the House feels like curling up under a blanket in a quiet home.

It’s gentle, cozy and unhurried. The game doesn’t rush you or overwhelm you; instead, it invites you to pay attention to your surroundings. Every small interaction feels meaningful, as if the houses and objects themselves are shyly sharing its secrets.

The atmosphere and the pixel art is where this game shines: the design is warm, slightly melancholic, and deeply comforting. There’s a tenderness in the way the story unfolds, trusting the player to notice details and feel emotions without spelling everything out.

This isn’t a game about winning or mastering mechanics. It’s about presence, curiosity, and quiet reflection. It is short, but also very sweet and memorable. Super recommended!

玩法设计得很有意思，玩家通过点击放置等操作来布置房间，亦或者是帮忙整理物品。解谜是与这个机制深度融合的，通过环境上的涂鸦等来提示玩家。每一个人都有各自的小故事，玩家在帮忙收拾的时候得以窥见他们的故事。最惊艳的解谜设计是通过照相机功能与玩家互动的炼金术士，这个设计实在是太精妙太好玩了
而且“布置”的这一机制本身也有很多操作，比如说长按右键可以竖起物品，相同物品可以堆叠（有一道解谜是通过这个机制来完成的），物品之间可以产生互动

对于游戏苦手的我来说非常友好，基本上没有什么操作难度，最后（在社区的帮助下）也是达成全成就了

如果你喜欢收纳整理，享受把杂乱房间变得井井有条的成就感，那么《呓语小镇》绝对是你的菜。
在游戏中玩家将扮演家政工，完成小镇居民的各类委托。而且在完成特定任务后，你会获赠房屋，可以用抽取或购买的数千种家具进行装修。
但是最让我着迷的，是它在温馨日常下埋藏的隐秘暗流。你会发现在一些物品上散发着紫色光芒、伴有符文的“异常”，右键疯狂点击就能击碎它们。而这一切，似乎都与小镇上那座无法进入、闪烁着数字的神秘金字塔有关。这种日常与谜团的交织，让探索充满了动力。
此外，游戏里还有很多用心的细节：地图上的小摊贩和自动售货机可以探索，地上亮晶晶的地方也许会有有用的东西。完成NPC的请求还能触发丰富的支线故事，甚至还能随处撸猫。
简直是探索向的天堂

Além disso, tem uma história envolvente que vai sendo contada conforme cada trabalho é feito, te instigando a descobrir os mistérios escondidos. Com Whisper of the House, você terá boas horas de jogatina, com um mix de tranquilidade, curiosidade e diversão.

-- the faint glow does nothing around hovered text, maybe turn it into a thought bubble for readability 
-- the top left text is impossible to read unless I pan the screen to have that section's background black
- Please eventually support controllers completely!

I initially got into it for the pixel art and the process of packing stuff away into rooms piece by piece until it looks perfect; but there's so much story and mystery to the game. The main characters have their own backstory and the game plays out beautifully as you find anomalies and charming hidden details in every shop and home you work in. Even though the day is passing there's no pressure to complete a project immediately so you can take your time to figure out where everything goes and interact with different objects for fun little secrets. I received this product as a gift but I would have no issues spending full price. A lovely cosy game to pass the time.

I had added the game to my wishlist because it was about furnishing houses and I liked the idea. But it's much more than that! You are in a pixel art world with lots of people to talk to, lots of cats to pet, and lots of things to collect or clean.
It's a very lovely game made with love and attention. There are lots of (side)quests, the achievements are easy to obtain and it's just so easy to play this game.
11/10 would clean again.
(Received this game as a birthday gift.)

If you liked Unpacking but thought "hey, this needs more diversity of rooms to unpack things in, and also could use, like, cryptic ♥♥♥♥ and magic"? This game's for you.
Cosy gameplay, charming art style, and I liked the puzzly bits.

This game has everything you need to forguet you are in the midel of a crisis. Humor, mistery, decoration and a lot of confusion on the characters life choices with their interior decoration.

A game for when your parents argue or you have a thesis to complete, or both!

One of my absolute favourites.

Combo cozy and spooky elements. I love it. It's like the Unpacking game but longer, more immersive, and has a little world with it.  I play on the steamdeck so there are some bugs, but not complaining because it's not branded for the steamdeck. I do wish there was an option to make text a little bigger to read (a me problem on the deck).
I have been having so much fun playing this game! Its cozy, mysterious, the graphics adorable. Easy to pick up, hard to put down. I do wish the controls were a little better on steamdeck.

This game caught my interest for the cleaning, organizing, and chance to put a room together. Its de-stressing for me and made me happy when I loaded it up. The small town and chance to make a difference in a "community" was nice as well. I found the game too quick, would have loved a chance to go back and redo some or have an opportunity to reset the space and start again. The magician's space was my favorite with the large room and upper floors as well. Wish I could have chosen to make it the main home for my character. I highly recommend but encourage people to take their time.

Cute, but very, VERY short and there's no actual ending unless you find every anomaly, in which case you get credits. Otherwise, you just suddenly stop getting missions and that's it. 
It feels like a lot of wasted potential, especially considering most characters and "secrets" never come back and very few of the buildings are ever used.

I like this game. It is soothing and creative. I also like the soundtrack, well, some of the songs are to funky for me so I'ts a little distracting. But thats only me. I love the storyline and the town. Its much to exsplore. I don't that after you're done organizing a house, even if you didn't organize it, they just its excellent. I would have like that there was a rating system and that you actually had to be good at it, working your way up to the top. 
It's also a little bit confusing, I dont understand when the game is over or not or maybe I'm just stuck right.
But overall its a fun game to play when you just want to rest your mind.

Absolutely adorable game. Just a touch of spoopy to it, but I could easily let my elementary school age kiddo play this and not be worried about it. There *is* a very light gacha aspect to the game, but it's barely noticeable, and you'll have all the in game currency you need to get more than you need. 

It's a very bite-size game...at 14 hours, I've managed to get all achievements and unlock most of the available decor. I might revisit this if I just want to get a random decoration mission from the notice board, but otherwise there's not much replayability here. Still, give it a go, it's tremendous fun for what time you'll have with it.
解压<3，画风很可爱，每个物品都有音效。主线不长但也不短吧。还可以自己diy房间。（我好想住在呓语小镇啊~~）

10小时全成就通关，游戏整体如果10分满分，我大概会给6.5分。
游戏分两个玩法，一个是自由装修，一个是主线按要求装修。
自由装修里的物件非常非常丰富，但是杂物数量占比大，相比之下大件家具就不太多，而且物品筛选交互有点麻烦。另外，抽盲盒是一次性购买50件家具，这让我对不断跳出的新物件很麻木。
支线里能看到试图讲温暖故事的痕迹，但是主线的逻辑还是让人感到莫名其妙……因为找到几间闲置的房子所以这些房子就归我了这种事也太成年人童话故事了吧？……
游戏里的小事件很有乐趣，体量比unpacking大一些。分类更新了之后找东西方便了许多，买家具如果可以送货上门就不用总是跑商场了。装修自由度很高，但是最大的公寓墙纸和地板居然不能换色。梦一个拍照模式下能显示小人在房间里行走，与家具进行交互。装修完的房子没人有点可惜。

정리게임을 좋아하는 사람이라면 추천. 마냥 정리만 하다보면 지루해지는데  나름의 스토리도 있고 이집 저집을 다니고, 히든처럼 숨겨진 미션을 수행해서 지루하지 않아요.
다만 한글지원이 안돼서 너무 불편합니다ㅠㅠ  리뷰에 한패 링크 달아주신 분 덕분에 한글화 적용하여 잘 플레이 하고 있습니다ㅎㅎ

드디어 한글화됐네요...! 처음부터 다시 즐기고 후기 써보겠습니다!

絵柄もゲーム内容もとても好みでした！
ストーリークリアまで１０時間ほど遊べ、ストーリーに関係なくお部屋のレイアウトを作ることもできるのでまだまだ遊べそうです。今後のアップデートでさらにシナリオ的なものが増えてくれたらうれしいなあ。
I can't stop playing! <3 if you're into pixel art style games, sim/organizing games, and Unpacking, this is the game for you!

I like it but honestly, I'm disappointed. This game is cute, it's fun to play, and the premise is really neat. The problem is right about the time I was getting really excited, gearing up to have to solve a mystery with the breadcrumbs I had found... it ended. No signs that the main quests were wrapping up, no final puzzles, nothing. It was just over. I was waiting for the next letter to come give me my next tasks (which I expected because there are a lot of buildings in the town and some of the quests are very interesting takes on the character's role), but nothing showed up. The mystery underscoring the whole time is wildly anticlimactic. 

On a more petty note of dislike, one of the houses you unlock to decorate is hot pink and bright orange with no way to change those colors. I hate bright orange.

All told, it's not a bad game: some of the tasks are nice and relaxing, the design is nice, and you can pet a lot of cats, but in terms of story it's really a letdown.
such a fun game!! very cozy and relaxing, and i appreciate the diversity of tasks/people you help

I've never been so immersed in an organizing game until I picked this up. Similar to "Unpacking", Whisper of the House provides interactive elements, engaging secrets, and exciting puzzles that adds a certain nuance to the overall experience. Even on the days when I felt stressed or overstimulated, this game helped me wind down and relax. You're able to unpack, organize, and decorate at your own pace (which for me, was refreshing). I highly recommend this game!

A delight of a game! 

It feels like a mix between Unpacking and House Flipper that’s visually styled like Stardew (all of which I l o v e). 
Truly feels like a trap if this is your kinda game, you simply can’t get out.. just one more task.. one more (until it’s 4 a.m.). 
The game is really well made, the pixel art style is top-tier. It’s cozy and satisfying. 

The only 2 complaints I have are: 
1) As far as my research goes, there’s no option to change the layout of your houses, make them bigger and in some you can’t even change the wallpaper which is a bit frustrating in a game that focuses on customization and decoration;
2) The story is short and feels a bit rushed. 

I feel like if the devs added more options for customization, added more furniture styles and expanded the story, that would truly be a game that many would come back to for years to come.

There is legitimately so much room here to expand and add new content that I truly wish they won’t let this opportunity to fizzle out.

This little cozy game is extremely satisfying, like a mix of Unpacking and The Tenants. It offers around 10-12 hours of game play time completing the main quests, but there are a ton of side quests that you can explore afterwards. I highly recommend it for anyone who enjoys decorating and organizing!

Okay, firstly I would like to say that I do LOVE this game. It's everything that I found addicting from Unpacking and then some. I love the story and the underlying creepy vibe. It turns a simple cozy, organizing game into an expanded experience. I've played through twice now and am still finding hidden bits. It's the perfect game to load up after a long grueling day, and a great way to unwind. Well worth the few bucks to support an up and coming indie game company. 

HOWEVER; there are a couple things that I wish were different. The biggest thing being I wish that there was a way to mass select objects to recycle, rather than having to drag everything one by one. It's tedious and I would rather have a clean inventory to choose from. The way that the item unlocking works makes for many duplicates that just ends up sitting in my inventory taking up space. This is a minor inconvenience and doesn't take away from the overall experience, but I do find myself bored after spending 15 minutes attempting to clean out the inventory. I haven't hit a cap/max in storage (yet), but it's still slightly annoying to sift through even with the storage organization update.

My other wish for this game is that I wish there were more accessible buildings and stories, but I understand that this could be because it's still a new game and hasn't been fully fleshed out yet. It's such an addictive game and I want to spend hours discovering everything in the world, but it just seems to go really fast. This could very much just be a me issue though... 

This is my first ever steam game review, and I'm hoping that the creators take my recommendation, but I'll still be enjoying this game regardless! If you're into cozy, satisfying, and wholesome games, I highly recommend Whisper of the House.

[h1]清理，收纳，装修，全能家政工为您服务！ [/h1]
先说结论，游戏体量小，主线短，有一点可再玩性（指接每日委托装修或者装修自己的小别墅），目前的价格和首发价48都不推荐，除非非常喜欢该类型，不然建议28再入，如果低于30入，还是很推荐的
画风上没什么问题，可爱的卡通像素，人物模型上有小部分奇怪，但家具都非常卡瓦。
玩法上包含了清理，收纳，装修，三个经典玩法了，也属于是真，家政工的职业范畴，没有耐心的小伙伴真心不推荐，摆便利店那个真的会让忍火大。
并且游戏全程需要跑图，角色走路真的慢，不能传送，虽然地图不大但也要自己操纵，急性子的也可以避雷了。
以及想认真且长时间装修的，目前游戏内物品分类有点鸡肋，非常混乱，不做主线任务，自己装修而言找东西要找很久。
主线整体节奏偏温馨，悬疑解密的成分其实很少，我个人是demo的时候感兴趣，把微恐删了搞这种方向我个人有点不太满意，但是喜欢纯治愈的可以玩！！

话说大家最后记得在金字塔00时候进去看看，那里是最后的剧情，我个人还是觉得主线结束的有点潦草了，，，[spoiler] 家政工努力工作变成创世神了[/spoiler]，真的没绷住了。

Great organisation game with a fun amount of missions. If you want to decorate your own house you can spend ages getting items and doing that too.
This is the best game, i love it! I hope it's gonna have a lot of content, it's so nice!

I played for about four hours and I feel like I've barely made a dent in this game. If you rush through it and slap down whatever furniture you find then yes, you'll get through it quickly. But if you play it for all it's worth, including exploring the town, meeting characters, finding secrets, completing each job to 100%, you'll end up like me. It starts out playing a bit like Unpacking, placing furniture in a neat and tidy way. Then the story begins and you find yourself searching for hidden clues and secrets, finding hidden rooms and solving mysteries. There's even jobs where you can design your own room based on a clients needs. 

The art is top notch, and for someone with the eyesight of a bat, I'm incredibly grateful that hovering over each item gives it a description so I'm not staring at pixels unsure of what it is. The story is fun, the decorations are adorable and I love the diversity of jobs given. Top notch game.

I love this! I hope they add more expansions or levels. It's basically Unpacked but, way cooler. More items, more freedom, different games and styles and unlockables. I hope there's more and more and more and more, forever.

Absolutely love this game! It satisfies my need for pixel art, organizing, and story, without giving me a "this is such a chore" feeling. And if you love the sound of achievements popping, definitely play this lol so many achievements and almost all of them you can't miss.

I already have 23 hours of this game and can't see myself getting sick of it anytime soon. I read a review that claimed it had similar gameplay to Unpacking, and while that's very true, I find this game has 10x more to offer than what Unpacking ever did. Whisper of the House has all the freedom of creativity that I, personally, felt Unpacking heavily lacked. It's plot puts you in the perspective of a housekeeper that can clean, organize, and decorate the spaces your clients assign to you freely! Not to mention the detail of the decor is absolutely outstanding. If you're a huge fan of the Sims, House Flipper 1 or 2, or Stardew Valley, I highly recommend Whisper of the House! Little hint: there is far more than meets the eye to what seems like a typical decorating space game. I adore when wholesome games throw in a bit of something more eerie to keep the player invested, and Whisper of the House does exactly that! I'm incredibly excited to see what's in store for the future of this game!!

The layout of the quests are so satisfying, beautiful and chill! I'm not a fan of sandbox decorating games, so I'm loving the storyline of the game and the fact you are given specific items for the townies quests. 
I really appreciate the devs- you can tell this game was made with a lot of love! 
Also the mysterious town reminds me of the podcast Welcome to Nightvale. So good.

It's not often nowdays that I enjoy a game enough to 100% it and want to keep coming back to it past that, but Whisper of the House does just that. I love the decorating aspect so much, and seeing others screenshots or pictures online has me wanting to go back to jobs I had already finished to redo my decisions, which this game lets you do!! I also love going into the community page for this game for inspiration.
the game is very enjoyable. its relaxing, keeps me engaged and wanting more, and the price doesnt feel too high. i also like the conspiracy nods. its worth playing overall
很可爱很过瘾的装修小游戏^^目前bug略多不过都不是太影响游戏感受的

面白かったので2周クリア、実績全解除済み

unpacking のような片付けゲーかと思いきや、街を掃除したりゴミ箱を漁ったりしつつ、依頼人の希望通りにインテリアコーディネートをしたり、過去や街に隠されている謎を紐解いていくゲーム。
難しい要素はなく、住人の会話や新聞などを気にかけていればエンディングまで躓くことなく進められます。
凝りすぎなければ5時間前後、配置や家具に拘ると一瞬で時間が溶けていきます。

謎解き要素も不快になるようなものはなく、全体的にカジュアルでありながら、人生経験によってはプレイヤーの心に響くものもあったりと塩梅が大変良いゲームでした。

良かったところ:
◼︎とにかく軽い。現行のPCならほぼ全ての人がプレイできるのではないでしょうか。
◼︎軽いのに部屋や家具のデザインはちゃんとしていて満足感がある。
一部デザインした人が違うな？と感じるものはあっても、全体としては纏まっている。
◼︎謎解きが理不尽ではない。
読み飛ばさなければ必ずピンとくるように作ってあります。
深読みしすぎると詰まりますが、基本的にはスムーズ。
◼︎意外と遊び心のあるギミックが多い。
〇〇がある→これに〇〇を入れたら？〇〇を混ぜたら？〇〇を使ってみたら？など、RPGでインタラクトできる家具や装置を見た時に思ういくつかのことを、実際に試せるものがあります。
実際にできる、ただそれだけで楽しいことを実装してくれることが嬉しい。

残念だったところ:
◼︎家具はそこそこ種類があるのに、ソート機能がそこまで便利ではない。
家具→椅子→床置き、のように絞り込みはあるけれど、全て絞り込めているわけではない。
しかし、キーワード検索では名前にしか反応しない為やはり出てこないものがある。
結果、一覧を延々スクロールしなければ見落としてしまうアイテムが多く出てしまうんです。
自分のプロデュースで部屋を作れる依頼もあるので、このアイテム絞り込み機能の制度を上げてくれると嬉しい。
なので、もっと売れて欲しい！！

新しく引っ越した街で引越し業者として家具の整理配置を行うゲーム。
住民の依頼を受けて、いろいろな部屋を時には掃除などもしながら整えていく。
依頼をこなすのに飽きたら街を探索したり、自分の部屋に置くための家具を集めたり、自由度は高め。
ドットで描かれる世界が綺麗でシステムもストレスなく遊べる。

[b] いろいろなところにいる猫を撫でることができる [/b]
非常有趣且小单元剧情丰富的游戏，值得购买！每一次房间整理都藏着许多故事信息，拼拼凑凑给你一个温馨且感动的小故事。[spoiler] 你甚至可以依靠“高维玩家”的身份改变他们原本的结局。[spoiler] 背景音乐大多活泼且十分好听，这个价格绝对物有所值！彩蛋极多！

ถ้าคุณกำลังมองหาเกมที่มีความผ่อนคลาย แต่ก็มีปริศนาที่น่าติดตามและชวนให้หาคำตอบ เกมนี้ตอบโจทย์นั้นมากๆ สนุกกว่าที่คาดไว้ 10/10 แต่ก็ยังมี Bug นิดๆหน่อยๆ ที่เจอส่วนใหญ่จะเป็นการแปลคำพูดของ NPC ไม่ครบ แต่ก็ยังสนุก หลังจากที่เล่นจบ นี่คือความรู้สึกและประสบการที่ได้รับส่วนตัว [spoiler] ตามที่บอกสนุกกว่าที่คาดไว้จริงๆ เพลินสุดๆ แต่รู้สึกว่าเนื้อเรื่องไปได้มากกว่านี้อีก เช่น  ความเป็นมาของ whisper, ตึกในสุสาน, puzzle ต่างๆ เป็นต้น แต่โดยรวมสนุก ที่ชอบที่สุดคือปริศนาของแต่ละคน เช่น ในบ้าน Luna มี Homeless ซ่อนอยู่, การหายตัวไปของ Ian [/spoiler] ลองไปหาซื้อเล่นกันดู :)

This game is instantly addicting. Obviously inspired from Unpacking, but with a more interactive twist, world, & characters. However, it does have its quirks. 

The actual interface itself can be confusing and mildly frustrating. Sometimes you want to rotate something one other direction, but you can't. The customize / remodel tool that allows you to change furniture, walls, floor colors & styles is a major selling point I would love so much more if it worked better. 

If there's a way to change the colors on interactable kitchen counters... well I never found it. Things like the stove and sink just turn on when I try to customize, and who wants one or two pieces the wrong color? Not enough color options either. 

The UI is large, and disabling it is frustrating because it doesn't show you item names anymore, map to switch floors easier disapears, as well as storage and design tool. I need those up, everything else gone. 

However, the game is fun, addicting, and feels unique even though I've played similar games.

i've enjoyed the game play and the pixel art very much. the coziness is chilling me. AND you may found a hidden additional quest is amazing.

I've been super excited about this game for a while, and it delivers everything it promised and more!

WOH is genuinely one of the best unpacking / organizing games I've played. First of all, the world is really big, and there are tons of different stores / areas that you can organize. The art itself is really nice and cozy, and there is so much furniture, plants, rugs, and general stuff to unlock. There's also a lot of different areas and stores that you can unlock, so it never gets boring.

Players get the space to decorate their own areas freely, but also unpack furniture in other houses so the aesthetic is always changing. There's a central storyline, but you could totally run around and spend your time decorating if you wanted to. There are no penalties in the game, no time restrictions, generally no harsh rules on where you have to put things, and a lot a lot of areas. 

WORTH YOUR MONEY!

美术风格很漂亮，家具选择很多装修体验很好，加上官方快速添加了分类筛选功能，之前想要的可改色家具筛选也添加了，现在装修方面已经没什么缺点；只要会喜欢装修游戏和像素的风格都非常推荐该游戏
自己喜欢的地方：家具改色很自然，灯光氛围很漂亮，透明墙体和地板很有趣；橘黄色、黄绿色、浅蓝色的家具效果都很好很喜欢；相机功能很完全，滤镜可以调节透明度很实用
装修方面以外，剧情里的一些解谜设计挺有趣的，我比较喜欢开始三四个小时的剧情，往后会感觉如果文本再多一点会更满足；最喜欢小鱼的房屋设计和剧情设定，很沉迷制作组在这里创造的氛围，整个游戏对我来说还是很温柔的
还有就是觉得小机器人很可爱，如果可以一直出现在家里右键会有几句随机台词就好了；期待后续可能出现的更新还有DLC，会想要继续支持的

Edit: Finished the game and completed all the achievements. Overall a game with relatively short playtime (10-12 hours), but it is very entertaining and not like your run-of-the-mill house designer game. There's an underlying story line and multiple side quests that makes the game feel less monotonous. Every house has its own theme and palette. The 42 hidden pieces/cursed items incentivizes you the explore the map fully.
中评。刚玩感觉非常有新鲜感，可惜的是制作组对于微恐悬疑这个赛道只是浅尝辄止，对于冲这个来的玩家有点食之无味弃之可惜了，也许把它当做一个纯装修游戏看待会比较好
非常治愈的小游戏，完成全成就也并不难，过程中一步步了解小镇的故事，大家都可爱捏

reviews.review:
把一个放置类游戏做的如此温馨治愈和暗藏玄机 让我找回了小时候玩4399小游戏的感觉
50多块钱看起来略贵 但是上班摸鱼玩使它拉满了性价比
这装修竟如此上头。剧情治愈玩法轻松，放置家具的声音很解压，适合放松

很解压的休闲的布置装修类小游戏，隐藏要素非常多，外表平凡的小镇搭配要溢出来的超自然要素，这不是很带劲吗！简直就是Gravity Falls！游玩期间惊喜不断。

但是有一点比较烦人，家具出现的顺序并不是完全按照房间出的？偶尔跳出来一两个不同房间的家具，然后带着家具切换房间又很麻烦，箱子里拿出来的家具还不能塞回去？也许是我没有发现，玩的有点繁琐。

This game is beautiful, cute, cozy and keeps you on your toes without stressing you. I thoroughly enjoyed it! The developers clearly put lots of love into this gem of a game. From its lovely art style to the soundtrack and the mysterious story, all the customization and interactions - I was sad when it was over! Though I'm sure this won't be the end ... hehe.
好好好，非常好，越来越好。本来觉得体量有点小了，但是后续更新很给力！！！！加油！
非常温馨可爱的游戏，主线剧情对我来说刚刚好不长不短，剧情结束后也有不少可玩的内容。如果在这个基础上加入一些可以选做的支线内容和宠物系统就好了

i play sim3, sim4, and i also love this game, it got still have huge room to grow, looking forward for the upgrade and i willing to pay for it.
爱了，期待更新！相信你们可以把它发展成一个有无限潜力的小宇宙！就像你们这个团队一样！
玩法跟unpacking差不多，但是内容更丰富，还会有点房产达人，剧情爷爷那里给我看得哈特软软的

Super cute and relaxing game. I love the story of it and the characters feel very adorable. The secrets are fun to hunt for as well. If you like cozy games like Unpacking, would highly recommend this one!
超可爱的装修游戏 虽然流程不是很长 但是小故事都设计得很有意思 期待更多后续更新以及DLC
非常棒和推荐的一款游戏，是个人的年度最爱和发现的小宝藏！本来是奔着休闲惬意+画风+喜欢收纳整理去玩的一款游戏，没想到还里面还藏着这么多的解密和剧情小彩蛋，真的好喜欢这种小惊喜的感觉，很棒的游戏！！！大推大推
Absolutely gorgeous game, must play if you enjoyed unpacking or like furnishing homes in the sims !!

かわいくて精巧なドット絵、のんびりした雰囲気に惹かれて購入したところ、思いがけず挟まれる微妙に不穏な雰囲気に心をつかまれました。
ストーリーもありつつ、行動や部屋のレイアウトの自由度が高いのがすごくいいです！
賛否あるかもしれないのですが、途中で「指定の箇所にアイテムを置いていく」タイプの依頼は、自分で好きに置く際のレイアウトのヒントになったので、私はすごく助かり＆楽しめました。
個人的には植物や書籍系のアイテムが充実しているのがうれしい……。
一気に進めてしまうのも楽しいでしょうが、私は平日の帰宅後にちょっとずつ進めるのが日々の楽しみでした。

日本語訳は多少違和感がありますが、進行に差し障るほどでもなく、普通にプレイできると思います。
お部屋作りが好きな方にも、ミステリアスな要素が好きな方にもお勧めです。
追加要素やDLCを楽しみにしています……！
一般，让人玩着玩着可以秒睡的玩法和内容，每个家装修需要用的家具一个一个塞，让人毫无规划可言，一开始全陈列出来让人慢慢摆是犯天条了吗，不喜欢这种半强制性引导的感受……没来及的退款的我太惨了

Very cozy game with a LOT of options if you want to do more decorating than puzzles. I was more interested in the puzzles and I wish there were a bit more, but I had a great time playing and collecting stuff.
if you like unpacking but don't like a little to the left, this is your game
好玩的！也很休闲，我刚开始以为就是普通的装修小游戏，没想到还有很多小隐藏，都得靠自己慢慢去发掘！50块花的值~

不完全只有裝飾房間，還可以同時探索發現隱藏的房間或物品、瞭解居民的故事及生活（甚至偷用他們的東西XD），可以協助讓居民的生活過得更好甚至找回初心，是很治癒的遊戲。同時每樣物品都有說明，很用心，也喜歡區分主線跟支線（接案裝潢）的部份，沒有時間上的壓力，可以依據自己心情遊玩。
最後的結局其實有點搞不懂，但好希望可以再追加其他居民的故事！感覺玩了這款之後就回不去一般的裝飾遊戲了，因為這款真的打破裝飾遊戲玩一玩就膩的問題...
總結來說很推薦這款遊戲～

[h1]インテリアデザインやドット絵の雰囲気がとても好み[/h1]

ドット絵の家具を自分の好みに配置したりできるゲームです！あつ森のハピパラとか好きな人にはおすすめ
コーディネートする家にもストーリーがあり、購入前にはきちんとストーリーがあると知らなかったので面白かったです。

[b]いい点[/b]
・翻訳が一部面白いけどストーリーもきちんとある
・家具や室内のカラーカスタマイズがありコーディネートが∞


インテリアコーディネートが苦手な人でもクエストに必須アイテムがいくつかあり
そこからイメージを膨らませて家具配置を考えることができるので、
苦手な人でも段々慣れていけると思います！


[b]ちょっと不便に思った点[/b]
・一部謎解き要素やストーリー要素がわかりずらい
・発売直後でsteam内や外部で調べてもわからないことが出てくる
・クリア後の要素が少ない

[h1]ネタバレありで不便に思った点を書きます[/h1]
謎解きがわかりづらい…2番目に書いたことと共通してきます。
海外のスタジオ製なのでsteam内ガイドも外国語で幾度となく翻訳とにらめっこしてました。一応全実績も解除しましたので海外の有志の方々に感謝。
特に分からなかったのは[spoiler] 花の交配や[/spoiler]実績にもある[spoiler] パンをオーブンで焼いたり[/spoiler]することがなかなか見つからなかったです。
またクリア後に探索して[spoiler]コーディネートする家[/spoiler]を見つけないといけないところもあって大変でした。
アップデートで緩和されたり追加要素が出たりするのを待っています。家具ももっとほしい！DLCほしいです🙏🙏🙏
休闲解压游戏，核心玩法是搞装修收纳，接受来自居民的委托，帮客户整理出非常好看又温馨的房间/店面，然后享受来自客户的赞美以及报酬。氛围感非常好的收纳整理游戏 ， 就是主线很短没一会就过完了 。 还有很多隐藏的支线小故事需要自己摸索 ，到这里就有点想念我爷爷了 T T 太好玩了 2代/更新快来 ！！
Highly recommend. If you are like me and have played Unpacking 20 times and are really sad they aren't making another one, this is the game for you! SO engrossing and satisfying and fun.

I went in with 0 expectations for the game, 'oh just another cozy, organising game'. Little do I know that I was very wrong and the next thing I know I'm hooked on to the whole lore of the game. The little characters, easter eggs are all very well made. Beautiful game, music , worth every $. 
Easily just a good feel-good game to wind down after a stress day at work.

They say it's cosy.

But I legit been scared the crap out of this game more times than I can count.

No joke, legit had to get on call with a friend because it scared me so much. Then we proceed to laugh about how I had bottle of alcohol on my shower rack.

10/10.

已通关全成就，一直在搞装修玩 ，仔细聊一下目前玩下来的体验
最近的更新严重影响了游戏体验，玩的让人特别恼火
1.首先是家具分类，感觉比之前更难找东西了，同一分类的家具在不同的房间里甚至内容不一样，还要换个界面找，分类太繁杂了...功能分类情况好点但用起来也没那么舒服，总之玩下来体验很不好，希望能优化
2.理想家的默认家具没法收回仓库真的是一个很让人难过的地方，本来就是目前体验各种户型自由装修的唯一途径，现在给你强制塞一些很割裂的固定风格家具，这还怎么自由装修，要么改成能收回仓库要么就快点把购买房屋实装...这下好了还得刷想要的风格，风格刷出来户型不喜欢不又得刷，纯折磨人
3.调色功能界面有bug，会出现调色后颜色不变或调色后鼠标右键点到其他家具颜色就跑其他家具上而本该换色的家具不变的情况
4.希望墙体边缘都能换颜色，有些能换有些不能换也很不方便，装不同色系的就会很突兀
5.不考虑出点新剧情吗？
6.灯光和光的图层问题，有些灯看起来会很亮实际暗得过分，有些又亮过头把周围所有东西都盖住了，窗户和灯的光即使被楼板挡住了也会穿图层发光，很影响视觉，希望可以优化平衡一下，以及希望理想家也加一个开关灯按钮
7.玩家拥有的房子除了初始的几乎都不能修改墙壁和地板，实在很难受…很大程度上限制了装修风格

以上均为个人游戏体验与建议，还是很喜欢玩小镇的，像素风格很可爱非常对胃口，可以说是做梦都想玩的装修类游戏（这下真玩上了），希望能做的越来越好！期待后续更新

对装饰房间 整理房间不感兴趣的就不推荐了，解谜和剧情量都很少，物品描述的大部分文本其实是可有可无的。
有一关便利店：货架在商品后才能掏出来，要把商品掏出来一部分放地上，然后掏出货架，然后再把堆放在地上的商品放到货架上。。。这样重复好几次才过的关。

Un juego super chulo lo recomiendo. Si te gusta los unpacking como esos tipos de juegos este es algo parecido.

Mi video:  https://youtu.be/I-INHVScluw

O melhor jogo para os fãs de Unpacking, principalmente para aqueles que amam desvendar mistérios e quebra-cabeças. 
A história do jogo é bem interessante, apesar de ser curtinha (espero que adicionem mais conteúdo futuramente), abrangendo vários personagens e locais distintos. A jogabilidade é bem fácil, só precisa prestar bastante atenção em alguns detalhes, e as interações com os objetos desbloqueiam momentos incríveis e enriquecem a história, dando profundidade aos personagens. 
E mesmo após finalizar a história principal, ainda há missões para continuar decorando locais específicos, fora a decoração das nossas próprias casas. A pixel art é muito bonita e o catálogo de decoração é bem vasto (só precisa de um pouco de paciência para adquirir tudo), mas acho que poderia haver mais opções de personalização dos objetos, paredes e pisos.
Eu me apaixonei pelo jogo desde a demo e esperei ansiosamente até o lançamento, e após platinar posso dizer que valeu a pena.
轻松中夹杂着一点悬疑的装修游戏，带着一点恐怖元素但也没强行搞黑深惨，流程很短，全成就很容易，在家具分类上感觉可以再改进改进，比如按颜色筛选，按房间筛选这种的
是很可爱的游戏！里面到处都是猫猫和猫猫的故事甚至还有猫猫的小坟墓。地图稍微有点大，公交车坐的有点迷迷。别的都很好玩！

玩了九小时全成就通关了，因为瘾比较大还搭配了很久的样板房，如果只推主线的话流程应该是七小时左右，总的来说内容比较少。不过主要原因是因为个人喜欢这类游戏，所以喜欢闷头一直整理过去，如果只是休闲玩的话内容大抵还算充足。然后以下是一些比较不满的和建议的地方。
[b]1.对于简介写的根据选择决定小镇玩家的命运感觉纯为噱头[/b]，事实上没有体验到太真切的这样的感受，游戏的主线和结局给我的感觉也就是噢噢就这的感觉。[strike]当然谁会过分在意一个收纳游戏的剧情呢[/strike]
[b] 2.放置自由度不足。[/b]有的家具碰撞箱做的太大又不能重叠感觉很影响搭配体验，因为个人很喜欢森系风格所以这里最主要要提出的就是墙面装饰绿植。还有样板房和主角自己的屋子，虽说可以更改壁纸地板颜色，但事实上不能随意拖动更改位置，先不论自己拉动墙面地板大小一类的操作，连自由增加减少窗户都做不到，也无法更改窗户样式；楼梯，护栏虽说可以更改样式，但是样式很少，甚至没有取消护栏这个选项，很多时候都给装修带来了更多的麻烦；以及每次随机到有二层样式的样板房都非常苦恼，因为也没有取消二楼地板显示的选项，虽说有透视模式，但是每次放置家具还是觉得仿佛盲人摸象。主线后续给予的房子更是连家具都不能挪动，实在没有觉得这个是属于我的房子。
[b]3.家具分类不够细致。[/b]看了一下大家都在提出这个问题所以就不多聊了，虽说目前有基础的分类但是找起来还是觉得很麻烦，希望能添加更细致的分类。
[b]4.增加可染色家具提示，增加可染色家具提示，增加可染色家具提示。[/b]重要的事情说三遍，建议在可换色家具的图标上添加提示类图标，为了找一个符合风格的柜子桌子每次都得把家具一个一个放出来看能不能换色。
[b]5.增加小地图。[/b]是可有可无的小细节，但是确实感觉也算是一个小困扰的点，在主线完成之后每次找做样板房的地方没有箭头指引，每次按地图又觉得麻烦，虽说后面给了公交车卡减少移动，但我连公交车站都找不到。以及收集全图鉴的时候满地图找商店的时候也是相同的心情。。。
总之个人建议大体就是这五点——大概也有别的地方但是暂时想不起来了。虽然写了这么多不太满意的地方但总之还是瑕不掩瑜。像素风装修收纳类游戏每一点都很喜欢，推荐所有想要放松一下的人购入！
无敌！！！！自unpacked开创整理收纳游戏流派后，青出于蓝而胜于蓝，这作简直是unpacked max plus！！！！不仅体量大很多，所有的细节、解密要素和菜单都既温馨又有情趣，感觉制作组都是十分有趣有品的人！！！感谢你们做出这么好的游戏！！！

I saw Melara playing this on Twitch and it looked like the kind of game I would enjoy and I was right!  I absolutely adore this game so much, I've been binge-ing it since I bought it. I have been going slowly too so that I can enjoy every minute of this game and everything it has to offer! It's cozy and there's some extra stuff that keeps it interesting as well ;) Thank you so much for this amazing game! It's one I will spend so so so so much time playing and its so unique!!!! <3  It's definitely cozy, engaging and immersive!
最好玩的搬家小游戏！画风温馨的同时支线故事有点微恐，主线和支线的内容都很有意思。玩法主要集中在整理房间，但是在整理的同时也会发现很多好玩的小彩蛋，以及解锁各种玩法。非常推荐的一款游戏！
귀여운 도트 그래픽과 다양한 에피소드들이 게임에 재미를 더해준다. 내 집을 갖고 꾸밀 수 있다는 것도 좋았음. 앞으로의 컨텐츠 업뎃이 기대된다! 일단 도트가 너무 귀여움..한국어도 나오면 좋겠지만, 일단은 번역기 돌려가면서 영어 공부하는 겸 하고 있다. 그리고 두 번째로 얻는 집이 벽지랑 바닥재 색이 안바뀌는데 업데이트 해줬으면 좋겠다..

推薦推薦

劇情很棒，每個居民都有屬於自己的故事
雖然刪了demo版寫的微恐劇情有點可惜，但整體來說還是很讚
關卡裡的小物品幾乎都標註了信息，值得停下來細品每一個文字

據官方說有1800的家具，每個家具能變換角度，部分還設計了背面
劇情完結後能接小委託自由設計房子，不會因為完結了就不打開遊戲了

這價格說實話不貴，遊玩過程中感受到滿滿的用心
心中喜歡的家政類遊戲絕對榜上有名
期待更新，後續推出DLC也一定支持

Arts is spectacular, and gameplay is fun. 

Unfortunately no full controller support: 
- any text field requires keyboard
- scroll bars need to be clicked and dragged instead of scrolled with right stick
- inventory management with a controller is so slow and mind nubbing that eventually you give up on it.

The game could also use a UI scale option, as a lot of the text is tiny. Other bugs have been reported already, so hopefully these issues are fixed in the future.

Overall pretty good game, but a bit pricy for what you get.

刚玩demo就感觉很感兴趣的题材，玩了一关就关了愣是等到正式版大玩特玩。非常好游戏使我电子养胃消失！不知道后面还会不会更新关卡目前的主线有点少五个小时就通关了，意犹未尽……一点小缺点就是有些地方的路不是很明显从入口走进去想从树or建筑之间走出来发现走不出来要绕一会和会被路上各种小物件挡住路，还有闪光的互动范围点有点太小了经常要点好几次才能互动上，以及没做带鱼屏的适配【明明画面选项里有但是实际上是不能用的会缺失画面
无论是在美术还是玩法上都是值得好评的，唯一美中不足的是流程太短了，根本玩不尽兴
I have played a little bit and I'm really enjoying it! Definitely worth it if you are a fan of cosy games like Unpacking or House Flipper :)

Waiting for the moment this game goes viral because it's an absolute delight that more people need to be aware of. So many cool side stories and secrets, a vast amount of decorations and a charming little town with lots to do. Buy Whipser of the House! Don't even think about it!

This is definitely one of the best, if not THE best organizational/unpacking/decorating game I've ever played. In about 10ish hours I gleefully helped the the town unpack and organize their ♥♥♥♥ and in return I got to click on a bunch of satisfying explodey stuff. The art is incredible, the story line is unexpected and fun, there's little to no grind when you figure out how to accumulate items from shops and then you just get to put everything down! 

This game was clearly made with an intense amount of love, and one of the best "cozy" games I've ever played. Highly recommend.

This is a really nice cute relaxing game. It was so addictive that I was so sad when I finish it. I hope they keep adding to the game. 

 I played the game solely on steam deck and it work really good for me. I had very little problems.

走走停停，时而强迫症，时而摆烂，时而事后诸葛亮地折返去休整，主线全成就12小时左右通关。如果想要玩一款可以让你放空休闲的游戏，呓语小镇真的是最好的选择之一。

小镇人物丰富且立体。主线叙事通过一个个打理房间的委托展开。节奏全在家政工的把握之中。在轻松优美的音乐中，我总是不慌不忙地在小镇漫无目的地游走。扫扫大街，修修消防栓，捡捡垃圾，与居民们闲聊，挖掘一下小镇的秘密……委托？今天干不完明天接着干，我得先去陨石酒吧喝杯螺丝刀！
游戏本身的音乐音效与物品描述、互动是绝大的亮点。我很愿意就把游戏挂着当作音乐播放器，它适合每一个美好的日子。物品描述时而幽默，时而搞怪，也不乏一些文学性与哲思。最可贵的在于，在每一条物品描述中，几乎都能够体会到对于生活的热爱。而作为角色对话并不太多的游戏，物品描述对于角色塑造可以说起到了举足轻重的补充作用。而意想不到的互动在符合剧情展开的同时，也让游戏具有了充足的趣味性。

主线剧情从委托切入，将空间完全转化为了角色个性与观念表达的窗口，帮助角色打理房间也就成了我们触碰他们生命的方式。她其实会把喜欢的东西渗透进她的整个生命，她其实有点强迫症，他的疯狂行径其实出于本可避免的伤痛……令人印象最深刻的当属游戏简介中也曾提及的遗物整理。与先前的生活或商店布置不同，我们不再是让空间染上主人们的色彩，而是要从这个世界消去它主人痕迹……看着一条条物品描述，仿佛她刚才还在沙发上微笑，转眼却从世界上消失了……借此，在引人怀旧的舒缓音乐之中，与本不相识的她似乎在我心上留下淡淡刻痕。这也让人不那么苦大仇深地，甚至是轻灵地开始思考起生命。


除此以外，游戏的内容非常丰富。这里有魔法、有炼金术、有鬼魂、有外星人、有meta要素，或许也有克苏鲁……？当然也有可爱的猫猫狗狗，与……类似的生物！诸多要素在本作中都显示出合理而和谐的样态，游戏中一些小游戏设置也是一样。总之，尽管要素与玩法丰富，但工作室清晰坚决地立足本作装修收纳的原点，让它们都仅限于为游戏的趣味性与内容丰富性服务。个人认为这也是难能可贵的。

作为主要玩法，游戏的家具物品众多，风格迥异，可定制性强，自由度极高。除物品房型基本固定的主线以外，通关后也会继续刷新的日常任务（即按要求进行自主房间定制）让人也仍旧满怀期待地想将游戏继续玩下去！
这样的自由度，让我一个嫌麻烦的人，就算是在进行日常委托时，每次都必然会忽略任务成功的提醒，硬是要把房间按要求布置到每一个角落。这可以说是非常出乎预期的。游戏中也有很多房型可选，通关后自由度甚至会进一步提升。谁能拒绝在这里布置自己的一间又一间理想的空间呢？（照相功能中的滤镜与贴纸好评！可以进一步为理想空间营造氛围！期待后续能继续更新！）

来呓语小镇做家政工，不仅帮人搬家具、布置房间，还能每天在小镇上捡垃圾消除异常。呓语小镇看起来只是一个有着精致像素画风的装修游戏，但其实有着更广阔的内容和玩法，体量也不小。游戏比起二月新品节的demo在操作上有了很多的提升，在剧情处理上也取得了很不错的平衡。

游戏的主线委托的设计挺不错，非常的多种多样。从纸箱里拿出来的不少家具有有趣的小描述，细碎的碎片信息能一点点拼凑出委托主的生活。有些物件描述模仿了现实里的事物，描述也跟着玩梗。主线委托中准备好的家具设计精巧，风格统一。不需要玩家再去费心挑选。家具的摆放和房间的大小都有提前设计，有很明显的位置可以来摆放。房间布局刚好能放下家具，不多不少。像是货架上的商品都是刚刚好能放满整个货架。对强迫症来说友好舒适。整理起来感觉很放松，很容易达到专注的状态。

不过也有些地方会有些难受，比如说衣柜和酒吧之外的冰箱不能打开来放东西。家具分类有些不清不楚。部分家具只能两个方向旋转，不能背对屏幕摆放。但是游戏的光影效果做的很好。游戏的光影效果也很好，特别是关灯的时候，光从窗外照进来很有氛围感。

有几个委托的剧情不赖，有波折还藏有特别的秘密，需要仔细寻找和互动才能发现。我们甚至还可以悄悄的在通过自己的行动来做好事，从而改变房主的生活。后续的事情还能登上小镇的日报呢。是难得用心来写的好故事的游戏。

主线委托形式很多样，除了新家入住还有清理老房间、新便利店开业上货、整理散落满地的家具、超市找猫等等。寻物找猫已经脱离的家装的范畴了，我可真是一个热心好镇民呀。找猫的那个超市里可以购买抽到过和拥有的家具，用委托的形式让玩家去到商场了解到购买机制是很巧妙的设计呢。

做完了主线委托也不用担心没有事情做。可以去任务版接任务装修特定主题的样板房。样板房委托有很多，只是没有剧情。样板房通常是平方不大的空房间，装修起来省心省力，还能弄得很好看。主角在小镇有很多大大小小的房子，都需要自己来装修。不过镇长奖励给我的大house东西有点多，比爱机斯坦爷爷家散落一地的杂物还要杂乱无章。突然从纸箱里抽出来一个大件也不知道要干嘛。这就是住大house的烦恼呀。

有些家具还藏有小互动。比如说点击水晶球，屏幕会落雪。闪闪发光的超英鱼人手办可以改变姿势。右键点击画板，笔会自己画画。除了这些家具自带的互动，场景设计中也有很多的互动。在酒吧可以自己调酒、炼金工坊的坩埚可以用来合成魔法物品还有可以改变颜色的火焰。便利店的冰淇凌机能打出超级可爱的兔兔冰淇凌。面包可以在面包店的烤炉中重复烤，其中还有一个牛角包，多次烘烤之后可以恢复原样。这个神奇的牛角包算是游戏中的不太容易发现的一个异常。游戏里藏有很多的小惊喜等待被发现。

异常就是会有些散发出黑色小诅咒图案的物品。可以通过多次点击来消除。神秘42博物馆里装的就是这些，我一开始以为博物馆顶上的数字是什么倒计时，每天都在减少，结束之后会发生什么，被吓得够呛。之后异常收集的多了，进馆发现里面收藏的是我消除的异常。一颗悬着的心就放下了，原来是收集呀。

小镇满地的宝藏垃圾。每天都能发现新垃圾。垃圾堆里不仅能翻出家具还能翻出钱。生机勃勃的小镇，很多的行人npc，连半夜都有人走。有个居民说他有一些很好的朋友，我们好到一起吃饭睡觉，打扮出行，就好像是同一个人。难怪游戏里有好多npc长得一样。小镇挺大的，在爱机斯坦家的机器里可以拿到公交卡。之后就可以在小镇快速旅行了。不过没有过场动画让我愣神了一段时间，还以为自己在原地没动。

Whisper of the House is a delightful decorating game with light story, puzzles, and mysteries. It has a combination of home design requests from other characters and freeform decorating. If you are a fan of [i]Animal Crossing: Happy Home Designer[/i] you will love this. Besides the decorating, I love the "discovery" aspect of the game, whether you are investigating mysteries, finding new furniture, or exploring the homes and lives of the townspeople. The town is so charming and I like just walking around after my day is over. There are tons of items to discover. I loved the very specific items like the [i]100,000 Reasons Why[/i] book. The furniture flavor text is cute and sometimes funny. Many objects are interactive. There are fun little things I did not expect to be able to do in the game like mixing cocktails. The pixel art and animations are so well done and make the world feel lively. 

The game has some nice QOL features that make the experience feel smooth and relaxing. Perspective mode lets you see items even when they are hidden behind other items. There is a massive catalogue of items, so I was worried it will become tedious to find things. I have not unlocked much yet, but I like that they included features to alleviate this. For example, you can sort items by room and it'll show you a picture of a little bedroom where you can easily select types of items like Desks and Beds. There is controller support for the game but the keyboard and mouse experience is better, since there are lots of small items and selecting them with a joystick can be tiring.

Such a fun game and am looking forward to playing more!

[h2]Updated Review[/h2]
[i]Updated after finishing story and unlocking all content except 2026 New Years.[/i]
They just released a new update, with new items and a sandbox mode where you can choose the size and shape of rooms and have all items available to decorate with!

My one critique is that while I love the huge variety of items, it can also be a little overwhelming. You won't see many of these items in the main story, so it took a while for me to familiarize myself with the furniture catalog during the endgame. This process is smoother in games like [i]Happy Home Designer[/i] due to the huge number of requests, and items being gradually introduced. However this is a personal preference, those who are used to sandbox decorating games with huge numbers of items may not feel overwhelmed as I did. [i]Whisper of the House[/i] is still one of my favorite home design games!

Does our little housekeeper get paid enough to do ♥♥♥♥ outside of their job description?

You arrive in Whisper Town and start your freelance-ish business as a housekeeper. Sweet! The main focus of this game is to organize and tidy up the homes (and shops) of your clients. Each one has a story to tell; how they moved here, what do they do for a living, etc. I immediately thought of this as the game 'Unpacking' but on a larger scale (since, you know, you're working for a whole town). There's also a tone of creepiness to it, which was a surprise. 

I loved the freedom you have when working on the interior design; however, there are some levels that just doesn't have enough space. Convenience stores, I'm looking at you. So, at some point, you have to do some weird organizing that probably won't leave you satisfied, but you'll have to do it nonetheless if you want to progress. By far, though, my biggest problem is the fact you can't rotate all furniture 360 degrees. This means that some furniture can only face the front and the side, which massively limits your vision for the room layout. There are also some levels where the game actually forces you to have the layout be decorated in a specific manner. It's not a big issue for me, but I imagine that it might leave some players feeling frustrated at the lack of true creative freedom.

Whisper of the House tries its best to maintain a storyline, but almost majorly fails. Not only am I really damn confused about that ending, the build-up to it was just wasted. However, I didn't expect this to have a really good narrative; just wanted to have some fun decorating and organizing. Maybe there'll be more content, especially with the recent update and all that.

Whisper of the House is a cozy thriller game where you organise houses :) It was very fun, I enjoyed the soundtrack, as well as the sudden switch-ups in vibes.
When the demo came out it was much more eerie, but I think there was some type of controversy that put the developers under pressure which is why it's much less sinister as before. 
Overall it was a very fun game, but I do wish it had more character interaction and/or more sinister undertones. 
I completed the ending in 6.9 hours, and it isn't a very long game, so for $22 (AUD) dollars I would be a little more cautious when it comes to purchasing this game depending on your interests and what you enjoy gameplay-wise.

作为这个价位的游戏，我认为主创团队仍需认真打磨。
首先说一下元素。最初买下这款游戏，吸引我的有这几个元素：像素房间设计、沙盒、清日常。进入之后发现实际上还有：抽卡收集、主线故事、彩蛋，附属功能玩法。
值得一提的是附属功能玩法，比如中间的烤箱、纸箱打包、炼药、调酒等，这些功能性的交互让我觉得很有意思。
不太认同的部分有：
1.[b]时间系统[/b]：看得出来有这几种考虑，主世界（小镇）时间季节流动，进入副本（任务房间）后时间照常流动，睡觉过天系统。在这么快的时间流速下，前两点就导致了第三点基本上毫无作用，每晚做完任务，再到外面逛逛，就可以收邮件领新任务了，根本没停。所以其实这三点就形成了不可能三角。
2.[b]室内人物[/b]：可以看到游戏专门在主世界摆了很多可以坐下的长凳（3A大作梗），既然这样，为什么房间内反而不能控制人物进行交互，还可以催生过家家、走迷宫等各种玩法。现在的交互更像是unpacking这类游戏的点击模式，只能说这一块真的太遗憾了。
3.[b]装饰玩家社群建设[/b]：游戏里有很多不同主题的家具，其实对装饰玩家来说需要有一定的收集度，但是收集的因素靠抽卡（虽然体验下来对于未抽到的部分可能有一定的概率加成，而且钱也管够，没有让我卡在最后几个物品上）。玩家可以领日常委托，但是日常委托的检测形同虚设，随便摆几个家具就可以通过。至少应该给各类家具增加一些隐藏的tag，然后检测这类家具的出现次数，判断这个房间是否符合要求的主题，这一点技术上应该可以实现，只是需要足够细节。另外呢，现在视频社交平台可以看到有人发自己做得房间很好看，也有一定的交流。所以我非常遗憾游戏没有能内嵌一个互相评分的系统，可以点击进入别人设计的房间并且评分，达到多少评分可以得到额外的奖励。
此外呢，主线故事有点贪多贪全，然后用一个完成美梦的外星人来串联，每个留下的印象不太深刻。加上节奏接二连三让人玩着玩着只想快点过了主线进入后面自由发挥的阶段。玩到后面就是感觉这个游戏也就贵在家具体量上了，但真要谈体量，自由上色家具、一些类型（如果蔬、名画、可晾挂服装、床上用品等）是不是还有更多扩展的可能？总之就是30-60区间价格的游戏，我会报有更大的期待。期待游戏会更新

没有什么是家政工搞定不了的。——《呓语小镇》

《呓语小镇》是一款有着精美像素画风的家政模拟游戏，有些奇怪且未知的东西隐藏在这个表面祥和的镇子上，我的出现会对这个镇子带来什么影响呢？

我是一位刚工作的新手家政工，今天刚到呓语小镇上班，一来到这就接到了第一个单子，不仅需要帮对方摆放并整理家具，还需要清理污渍。不就是摆放家具嘛，我在新手教程里已经…不对，我上班之前可是接受过培训的，简简单单，来到雇主家的洗手间，先把污渍清理干净再摆放好家具和其他生活用品。那...要是有的污渍看不清在哪里怎么办，我可是接受过培训的，直接点击这个任务左边的问号就会有提示出现…不对，我眼睛好的很，一眼就能够看到所有的污渍在哪里了，不存在这种问题。客厅和洗手间的家具摆放和清洁已经搞定了，就剩下最后的卧室了，让我看看怎么回事。哇，这难道就是传说中的《莎丽娜蒙》，不晓得是不是真的，万一是真的呢，我不是可以拿着一样东西出去嘛？难道说，算了，我可是有职业操守的，我立马就把手上的画挂了回去，这时才注意到墙上怎么有缝，让雇主看到了怎么办，看我的右键打扫大法，突然听见叮咚一声，墙上的缝都变成大洞了，人生，工作，全完了。抱着破罐子破摔的想法，我进到了洞里，发现这居然是一间密室，下面连接着洗手间，周围不仅有人生活过的痕迹，而且还有大量的生活用品，墙上画着奇怪的符号像在是召唤什么。来不及细想的我立马从洞里退了出去，把画挂回墙上勉强把这个洞给遮住，直接给雇主交差，没想到，还获得了极高的评价，难道？我真的是个天才？

游戏的主要玩法在上面就基本介绍完毕了，最主要的就是摆放家具和清理污渍，有时候还有些其他要求，在解决这些要求的同时，我们有时候会遇到某些奇怪的事，比如密室、被困住的魔法师、穿越时间等等事件，每个事件的主题都不同，而且带有部分解谜，玩起来并不会觉得枯燥乏味。游戏的大晖日报是这个游戏主线的重中之重，会利用报纸提醒你有哪些奇怪的地方或者是事情，友情提醒我们需要注意博物馆的数字。随着游戏流程推进，我们会获得自己的房子，我们可以自己去抽盲盒或者去直接购买物品，学习并借鉴雇主的房子或是自己diy自己的房子。除了获得自己的房子之外，我们在主线的最后会见到神秘来信的发信人——“祂”（此处不做过多剧透），所有的一切都得到了完美的解释，结局也是完美的，没有什么是家政工搞定不了的。

游戏的音乐和音效做的都非常棒，像素画风细腻且柔和，剧情有反转还挺感人的。总的来说，该游戏做的非常棒，非常推荐想要放松身心的玩家购入游玩。

[h1][b]绝美画风与装修布置的艺术[/b][/h1]

《呓语小镇》是一款超级超级可爱的游戏，玩家要做的就是帮助小镇居民完成装修和收纳等任务，休闲治愈的玩法配合精美的像素美术，玩起来非常解压。

喜欢Rogue游戏的玩家一定听说过元气弹工作室，这家制作组推出过备受好评的类幸存者《通神榜》和搞怪的构筑游戏《元气小剧场》。
本作正出自于元气弹，这次其也是充分发挥了自己的特长，精心打造了一个庞大的像素世界，里面充满了各种小物件，让人爱不释手。

游戏主角是个全能的家政工，刚刚搬来这座小镇，其很快就接到了居民们的订单，开始着手装修收纳任务了。
本作的玩法很简单，其实就是布置房间，主角有个机器人助手马克，其可以从手中携带的箱子拿出各种日常物品和家具，玩家只需要将其放到房间中就可以了。
除了很少一部分内容外，大部分物品都可以由玩家自由放置，突出一个想怎么放就怎么放。

如果想让房间好看点的话就要费一番功夫了，可以从物品的类型入手，将其放置到客厅、厨房、卧室、洗手间等地方，小物件还可以摆在大家具的上方，此外一些家具还可以打开存放物品。
得益于超强的美术，只要稍微放的整齐一点画面就很漂亮了，游戏也提供了配套的照相模式供玩家发挥。

除此之外，角色还可以在镇子上闲逛，随手清理垃圾或是购买物品用来装修自己的小屋。
游戏中还有一些秘密供玩家发掘，比如房间中隐藏的密室、小镇中闪烁的建筑物和巨大的数字等。

整体来说《呓语小镇》这套玩法简单而有趣，将杂乱的房间变整齐，或是化毛坯为豪宅，这个过程既解压又治愈，喜欢小而美类型的玩家不要错过。

Whisper of the House is like its name: An inaudible sound, dismissed and forgotten as quickly as it is heard. Most of what is here is pilfered from other, better videogames, reused without intention or understanding. Its primary Housekeeping activity is a hollow imitator of Unpacking, devoid of heart and creativity. Its vague, adventure-style puzzles should be its most interesting feature, but the player character is given no compelling reason to seek them out. I’m determined to compliment at least one thing about Whisper of the House, and here it is: Its pixel art graphics are wonderful. The sheer number of objects available to place in houses feels like where the most care went into this videogame’s creation. A videogame needs to do more than look nice to be appealing. At this, Whisper of the House fails in every corner of its beautiful city.

I feel as though the game has simultaneously too much and too little going on. Most of the levels do not give me that "just right" feeling that I love in organization games. The game doesn't care where things are, the characters are flat, and some of the gimmicks, like picking up trash are tedious and there should be a more streamlined way to do them so they FEEL satisfying. The spookiness felt thrown in and I didn't have the want to follow the quest lines as I was not connected to the game, my character, or the story. Also the storage and organization for the homes was atrocious and lacking a filter to ONLY SHOW what items you can PLACE. I REALLYYYYY wanted to like this game but I had to stop playing as I was getting more frustrated by what the game was lacking than any fun of the organization (which was minimal to begin with per the above comments).

[h1]My New Favorite Cozy Game... Until It Very Much Wasn't[/h1]

So I picked up Whisper of the House on a whim because my brain needed a complete and total shut-down. I was looking for something with zero combat, zero complex puzzles, and 100% vibes. Let me tell you, for the first hour or so, this game delivered that in spades.

Right from the start, the graphics are just stunning. We're not talking hyper-realistic, next-gen craziness, but a beautiful, painterly art style that feels like stepping into a living watercolor. The house you explore is drenched in the golden hour glow of a late afternoon sun. You can see dust motes dancing in the light streaming through the bay windows, and the wood grain on the floors looks so detailed you can almost feel it. The textures on the plush armchairs, the worn leather of old books, the way the light catches the porcelain of a teacup—it’s all incredibly thoughtful and immersive. It’s the kind of game you play just to be in that space.

The gameplay is simple: you just wander through this empty, gorgeous house and interact with things. You can water the plants on the windowsill, which then seem to perk up and glow a little. You can put a record on the vintage player and this wonderfully soft, lo-fi soundtrack kicks in. It’s meditative. There’s no goal, no timer. You’re just… existing in this peaceful, quiet space. It was the perfect digital detox.

 If you're looking for a truly unique and atmospheric game that masterfully plays with tone, you have to try this

If you enjoy tidying up games with a hint of supernatural mystery, this game is a fun way to spend a few hours unravelling a few town secrets whilst doing some decoration. 

I've had a lot of fun so far finding out about the place I'm in and its people, and feel there's much more to uncover. There's no deadlines per se, but the game does have days and hours present. I've skipped a few sleep nights and there doesn't seem to be an issue, but going home and "resetting" the day is a good way to get a sense of the passing of time and the evolving of your quest.

The only thing I'd really appreciate in this game would be a tally of the total objects I need to unpack in a specific room, because I've had some difficulty fitting everything in a particular place where I didn't expect there to be so much large furniture!

All in all, it's a stress-free game with some puzzles to solve and tidying up to do.

療育的像素風場景整理遊戲，意外的蠻多劇情含量，遊戲整體豐富有趣

優點:
1.相較其他整理遊戲會刻意打亂場景物品、打亂物品取出順序，這個遊戲有根據物品類型安排取出順序，玩家可以更有序的擺放物品，也更容易快速理解物品適配的位置
2.劇情穿插在遊戲過程，也會有一些主打劇情的房間，玩家可以通過整理、與場景物件互動觸發劇情，劇情與遊戲玩法融合得很好
3.遊戲世界以一整個城鎮地圖呈現，且玩家可以在城鎮自由走動探索撿垃圾(哈哈)，讓玩家與城鎮更有參與感，產生一步步打造城鎮的成就感
4.城鎮有許多可以讓玩家自由規劃的房子，在整理之餘，玩家也可以自由打造個人空間
5.家具、家飾抽獎池友善，出未解鎖物品的機率很高，不需要農金錢

缺點:
整體沒有什麼問題，以下狀況大概率是我方向感不好才會有的問題哈哈
1.雖然主線會有GPS指引，也可以自己設圖釘指引，但還是希望可以有個主畫面左或右上角的小地圖，減少玩家頻繁開地圖找地方的情況
2.主地圖部分，希望各地點標示可以設計不同的圖標，而非全部都是房屋圖樣，雖然有做顏色區分，但想去特定地點時，還是需要用游標一個一個找，有點麻煩
Bom para passar o tempo, bem cozy, se voce gosta de organização voce vai adorar passar tempo nele e se envolver com os pequenos misterios que tem para resolver

If you like pixelated interior design, you'll definitely enjoy this game. While the storyline was interesting, I found it rather secondary to the gameplay itself. Most of my time was spent designing layouts and giving each space its own aesthetic. Overall, I really enjoyed the atmosphere of the game and can see myself coming back whenever new content is added.

I do, however, wish for a few things: an eyedropper tool, post-game unlockable furniture, and changing the layout of the starter home. 
- The eyedropper tool would make it much more convenient to make everything match without having to copy/paste the HEX code. While not necessary, it would be a nice QOL feature. Another QOL feature that I'd like would be to allow players to duplicate furniture so the consistent color-changing of customizable furniture doesn't become tedious.
- This may be a personal bias, but I always love games that have post-game content to keep players hooked. There is already a lot in game, so this is by no means necessary, but having some sets of furniture hidden until the main storyline is finished would be cool (and a reason for players to finish the story). 
- This feature is already throughout the game, so I was surprised when it couldn't be done. Maybe not even changing the base layout, but allowing for players to purchase expansions (e.g. a courtyard, a non-lofted bedroom) using vouchers could expand on the freedom the game already encourages.

Even without the aforementioned suggestions, I can say I would recommend this to my friends who enjoy the cozy-building lifestyle.

如果你和我一样，对 “从混乱到整洁” 的治愈过程毫无抵抗力，那《呓语小镇》绝对能让你一头扎进去就舍不得出来！作为一款全成就仅需 8 小时左右的轻度游戏（俺的时长），它最绝的地方在于 ——解锁所有成就后，我依然会主动打开游戏，就想安安静静收拾房间。
游戏的核心玩法就是整理各类场景：堆满杂物的书桌、乱糟糟的衣柜、散落着小物件的置物架…… 把东倒西歪的书本码齐、将零散的摆件归位、擦拭掉污渍让家具重现光泽，整个过程没有时间压力，没有复杂操作，只有肉眼可见的 “变整齐” 带来的极致解压感。尤其是看着原本杂乱无章的空间，在自己手里一步步变得井然有序、温馨治愈，那种成就感和放松感，简直是当代人解压的 “精神按摩”。
更让人惊喜的是它的可爱画风！丰富的色彩搭配、萌萌的物品造型、细节满满的场景设计，每一个角落都像童话里的小世界。不管是阳光透过窗户洒在书桌的光影，还是收拾完后的暖灯特效，都能瞬间治愈坏心情，连整理杂物都变成了一件充满仪式感的快乐事。
而真正让人 “上头” 的，是游戏里藏不住的小巧思和小互动！（为了不剧透，俺就不说了）这些刻意的小设计，让整理过程不再单调，每一次点击都可能有新惊喜，越玩越觉得有意思，完全停不下来。
不需要费脑攻略，不用肝进度内卷，《呓语小镇》就是这样一款能让你放慢节奏、享受当下的治愈神作。强烈推荐，线下已经安利朋友玩啦~

Very fun Unpacking-like game that also does its own thing and keeps the gameplay new and refreshing. In some cases you are unpacking someone's belongings and decorating their home. At other times, you are setting up someone's shop where everything has its own place, or tidying up an abandoned property. The game also has plenty of secrets and even puzzles that make a fun addition to the unpacking and decorating gameplay. You can get several properties of your own to decorate with furniture you've unlocked, and the devs have updated the game plenty with more decor and missions. There's also a decent amount of side/post-game content once you beat the main story. Definitely recommend if you like decorating or games like Unpacking!

Llegué a este juego porque estaba buscando algo similar a Unpacking (porque amé ordenar y decorar espacios, si al mismo tiempo implicaba ir contando una historia, o, en este caso, muchas historias). Cumplió totalmente esa expectativa y la de ser un juego relajante y reconfortante, pero también es un juego con mucha personalidad propia, por el pequeño mundo abierto y  todos los elementos sobrenaturales y extraños en el pueblo. 

No diría que me conmovió tanto como Unpacking, pero quizá es porque aquí, más que profundizar en una historia y crecer junto con alguien, se trata de conectar con pequeñas historias y llenar un álbum de personajes e historias interesantes. 

Hay un montón de objetos y accesorios de todo tipo (tu casa podría ser japonesa, china, gótica, cyberpunk o llena de cosas con perritos y gatitos) además de que consigues varias propiedades en el pueblo, así que además de terminar la historia, puedes seguir pasando horas personalizando los espacios.

It's an interesting blend of genres.

Yeah, mostly it's "unpack things and put them... somewhere" kind of a deal, for some relaxing and very freeform experience. For someone that likes decorating, it's a nice chill time.

And at the beginning - that's all there is. But the game slowly unravels a little bit more - some of the "jobs", are very simple "put things exactly where we tell you", which also isn't all that exciting.

Then you uncover that some of them have "special" requirements - you need to clean some stuff, or reorganize them. This adds a little more gameplay to it, and it makes it a more engaging experience for sure.

But then on top of that - it turns out that there are some "hidden" secrets and objectives, that you can figure out through observing the environment, and putting things together on your own - without the game telling you anything about it. Now - it turns out, that the game is full of those secrets - both in the jobs and in the "open world". It adds a little something to more of a lacking experience, and makes it a nice and interesting mix.

There's also all sorts of things here - collecting decorations for your own houses, absolutely free-form decorating of rooms, and tons of little secrets - for those who like completionism, or specific decorating vibes. They exist there - but even if you're not into it, they don't get in the way really - so it's a nice extra.

All in all, this was pretty enjoyable as a chill experience, with a little puzzling - and definitely a little surprise how it is a little bit more than a simple unpacking game - and how this weird mix actually works.

"Whisper of the House" is a cozy unpacking and decorating game that will appeal to players who enjoy bright, charming pixel art and relaxing gameplay focused on collecting, organizing, and environmental storytelling.

For completionists, achieving 100% completion is very reasonable and can be accomplished in under 15 hours. My playthrough took me slightly longer due to me having to backtrack. Only two achievements I had any real challenge at the end. The first, “The Final Clue,” was difficult primarily because I overlooked an interactable element in the newspaper office. My advice to players should is to carefully examine all interactive objects to avoid this issue.

The second challenging achievement was “Colorful Celebration.” I recommend completing this achievement before unlocking “Crossing Dimensions.” While it is unclear whether this was due to a bug or intended design, I was unable to complete the achievement with Ian present in the room, in my playthrough. 

For players who encounter difficulties, there is an excellent 100% achievement guide available that is useful for tracking down any remaining achievements you might me missing. Importantly, there are no missable achievements, and all can be obtained through attentive gameplay and normal progression.

Overall, "Whisper of the House" is a relaxing and enjoyable experience that offers a satisfying and low stress achievement hunt. I would confidently recommend it to fans of cozy games and completionists alike.

This game is incredibly adorable! You probably didn't need me to tell you that, though. The art style and many items within it - including the buildings around the map are all very well done. The achievements seem daunting, but I'd say for 75ish of them, you mostly discover them as you go along.. which proceeds very fast. My hours on it aren't correct either. At one point I left the game open on accident for a few hours, so that sucks, but you get I'd say roughly 8-10 hours of gameplay (maybe!) depending on how you play. There is an infinite game loop where you can get tasks everyday, but the rooms become mostly the same, and the furniture for them becomes tedious/ repetitive. Depending on you, you might like designing for the same few themes over and over, but that's not for me. 

To my achievement hunters out there, don't be afraid of the amount! Seriously, I feel like it didn't take me very long to get these. If I would have focused up instead of indulging myself in the game, I definitely could have done this faster, but that just goes to show it's pretty great to play.

I do REALLY wish there was more to do, though. We have a few quests from people to fix up their houses and a few other buildings - which is super neat, but then suddenly it's over. For $15 when I'm always comparing things to stardew, you really want more to do, and you just don't get that in this. 

If you are looking for a cutesy game that's relatively easy to beat, with a few decently difficult things to figure out, but mostly straight forward puzzles.. then I think you'll enjoy it! 

As a designing game, it felt freeing, but there are also limits to that. Maybe there's an item picker to be able to copy or find items similar to it within your catalog, but I never found that if it does exist.. and I think it would be super convenient to have. I also found a few issues when trying to renovate. Sometimes the floor or wall color picker thing would be off of the screen and I had to reselect and try to move the camera a bunch to get it to stop doing that. Not game breaking, but annoying. 

Anyway, this game is cute. There's not a ton to do in it, like I expected there to be. The museum collection for example - very easy to fill. I think they were trying to make it feel bigger / better than it is, but it's similar to unpacking. You get a few story scenarios, and the difference is the cool things you discover along the way. Sorry if this review is everywhere and nowhere, I just woke up, hehe. 

Anyway, hope it helps!

As my final warning - this game is VERY bright. For anyone with sensitivities to that, just be aware. You can turn lights off in the houses. It does make it a little more difficult to navigate, but that is my work around. The daytime in the game, however, is a little unavoidable.

While I am still thoroughly enjoying the post-game sandbox content even after completing the main missions, I can only barely recommend this game.

Firstly, what this game does well is building upon the room organization concept of Unpacking and making it into a full fledged game with a bigger town map and various quests/tasks to do. It also allows you to collect and buy furniture to decorate your own apartments.

What I didn't like about this game is some of the choices it made. First off, you can finish the main missions in about 10 hours, and then you're left with post-game content that's half-baked. There's a board where you can accept requests and decorate rooms for townspeople, you get to use each furniture item in your inventory at unlimited quantities, but when you decorate your own house, you are limited to how many of each item you actually own, so you have to buy more at shops. Earning in-game currency post-game becomes tedious as the townspeople's requests start repeating over time and you have to keep doing the same tasks over and over to grind cash.

Secondly, the main missions themselves had a lot of unrealized potential. I can tell the creators tried to make the game a little spooky, but were afraid they would go overboard with it, so they ended up being too tame as a result. A lot of the supposedly scary elements felt out-of-place and the tone was inconsistent throughout. They could've just kept the game cozy and warm, or lean further into the creepy, unhinged, conspiracy vibes. The end result is a weird middle ground that doesn't add much value.

The game also occasionally suffers from bugs like disappearing furniture, requirements not being flagged as done even though they are, and lagging when there is too much furniture (but my computer doesn't lag when I play other games so it's probably an optimization issue). The furniture catalog also needs some quality of life enhancements like better sorting, filtering, maybe allowing players to filter furniture by theme or create their own categories. Sifting through a long list of furniture to find the right thing when you don't know its name is rather time-consuming.

The game would largely benefit from bug fixes, adding more missions, more varied ways to earn money and improving furniture selection functionalities. It's usually a good thing to have a lot of furniture items to collect and choose from, but without a good way to access and use them, the sheer amount actually becomes daunting.

Whisper of the House is a short and sweet game that starts cozy and gets a little mysterious. I'd liken it to a big scoop of mac n cheese with just a little sprinkle of cayenne on top. It is the appropriate and satisfying length for the features and story it offers. There are just enough jobs to give a decent story if you're here for that sort of thing and enough freedom to artfully decorate as much as you want. Better for folks that like clutter more than minimalistic decorative styles. But again, it's not a huge game intended to take forever to complete. 

The things I didn't really like/am hoping for patch/DLC/QOL improvement for is some items can't do the 4-view rotation if there are items set on top of them, like dressers and beds. It's a little frustrating to have to take everything off and put it back on or take off the headboard and duvet and put them back on. I also wish there were more jobs with characters/bonus grading system. The first house you properly makeover is Luna and her dog where she requests her dog stay in her bedroom. Cute! I wish there were more requests like this and if the game gave bonuses based on following those instructions even on side quests like one where a client asks to 'a cozy cabin', it would be nice to see that you get points using certain furniture if it had tags, otherwise it feels like the side quests are just randomly generated prompts (which they might be). My only other complaint is the veeery tiny presence of pet care furniture but no pets. There's a story chapter with what I felt were BIG HINTS toward rehoming/building a home for all the stray cats around town. and that simply wasn't the case. there's no pet-owner catering in this game.

When a simple decor game turns into a detective mystery with black magic and aliens... Whisper Of The House is a unique and fun game where we play as the most exemplary employee of a cleaning company. We meet people, clean their homes, organize their belongings and learn their stories. Some are shared by them as we continue to visit, while others are secrets awaiting to be discovered by our detective intuition. Finding strange notes, doodles and anomalies. It is up to us to piece together the information and reveal the hidden story behind this strange city.

As for the achievements, they were fairly easy to get and the majority can be obtained on the go as we progress from one house to the next. Anything missed can be obtained afterwards. No additional playthrough required. Overall, we were missing only 5 achievements, and the guides provided by the community were quite helpful.

I really recommend this game to anyone who loves decorating or anything similar to the games Unpacking, and Unbox The Room. Decorating in Whisper Of The House plays quite the same, with the addition of a unique layer of mystery and quests to unfold... Absolutely brilliant. I would love to see a sequel!
