写这个评测的时候感觉理性和个人品味在打架。非常好收纳游戏，画风音乐和内置的其他小游戏都很不错，而且全解锁家具以后还可以当成装修模拟器无缝建设oc房间。
……但这游戏的流程实在是太短了，短到我六小时打完的时候还愣了一下。虽然确实有剧情，但有和没有差不多；虽然确实有不少彩蛋和玩梗，但有和没有差不多。 哪怕你花点时间做全成就，也会发现这些东西实际上没什么解密要素，就是纯粹的大家来找茬，找到了也就用鼠标点点，没有什么额外的东西。确实，拆包装流程更短，但拆包装这个游戏暗含叙事，但呓语小镇不太包括这些，或者说太简单了，太大白话了，感觉像在水字数而不是讲故事。从个人口味的角度我愿意给这个游戏好评，但同样我认为这游戏的体量并不值这个价格，至少不值得原价。

很好玩！！！！玩过demo就准备入了，当时看见说露娜那关改成松鼠人，一下子就阻挡了购买热情，本身就是微恐游戏，又上了steam，实在没必要太谨小慎微，失去了游戏性。幸好露娜只做了一点小改动，整体还是保持了微恐的调性。看评论区有人说什么墓地那关太恐怖，我实在忍不了了。我算胆子小的了，都没有觉得墓地那关很恐怖，哥们，这都感觉不适劝你还是不要玩这个类型的游戏了。。。。这点胆量怕不是做噩梦都要吓得不敢睡觉吧？呓语小镇总体可玩性很高，哪怕玩过demo都觉得很多小细节很好玩，很有意思。尤其呓语报社那，挺有意思的，很多可交互的点。我很喜欢新关卡的神秘庭院。期待呓语小镇未来发布更多的新内容！！！！！

Really cute and fun game that needed a bit more. I would pay extra for like double the original game length. Take my money lol. No but it did need more. Kinda a let down but only because there wasn't way more to the original story line!
好玩，希望家具品类样式多一点，如果可以玩家自由创作家具就好了，家具摆放自由度希望也能更高一点

really fun, cute and imaginative cozy game not like any other i have played. There are elements of mystery, without spoilers , i will say they defo give it an edge other games like this sometimes 'lack'. I love that the player has creative freedom on how the spaces we design look and that each job has a different story and immersive elements. the furniture and aesthetics of the game are super cute . the characters and stories that unfold during the game and jobs are refreshing , no one is the same and care has been given to the stories. i think im just waffling atp but overall i rly enjoyed it. its similar to the game 'unpacking' but less rigid and its stories and characters remind me of stardew valley. 10/10 would recommend ! <3 btw i discovered this game from gabsmoulders on youtube and i brought it and played after watching her so tyvm xx

Whisper of the House is a spooky cozy decorating sim. 
Cons: The ending left me asking, "Was that it?" and overall the plot was a bit lackluster.
Pros: I'm a sucker for pixel art and decorating games, and found it to be the perfect game to sit back and destress with. The cleaning and decorating mechanics were fantastic.
Funnest game I've played in a while, visuals are stunning, and stories along the way are so cool, love this game!
好玩好玩好玩！全成就+全收集了！装修物品多种多样还可以自由调色，我猛猛装！
如果你喜欢玩unpacking这类收拾布置屋子的小游戏，一定要试试，游戏体量挺大，而且中间还有小剧情，值得一玩。
Absolutely loved the gameplay and the story line! The artstyle and story progress is amazing, and think it's great pacing, I really wished there was more levels to it. 100% reccommed this game
玩法不难，整体也很轻松，是我为数不多全成就的游戏，多少得纪念一下

非常治愈的游戏 摆家具太轻松休闲啦 而且还有很多彩蛋 非常可可爱爱没有脑袋
结束了也舍不得删 等有空也再来布置一下自己理想的家 但唯一不好的我以为抽到就是永久有的……结果摆了仓库就没有了（）还得继续赚钱去抽家具。
Díganme que van a meter más contenido porque este es mi juego favorito, tiene todo lo que me encanta de un juego cozy y relajante.
Veeeery good cozy decorating game, with a surprisingly good scenario and pretty "dark" mysteries. I simply loved it!

I enjoyed this cute little decorating game and I definitely recommend it, if you love cozy games! 

I really like playing this, it's similar to unpacking, but the content of decorating is neverending (you can play this game forever), and there is a storyline which you put together by exploring the city, finishing decorating/unpacking projects, petting cats, searching through the trash, doing a favour for the mafia, etc. The gameplay is very relaxing, you don't have to stress about anything. A big positive is that this game can be played with your mouse, so it's very accessible! 

I find this game to be incredibly cute, however it's quite pricey for what it is. I completed the story in about 7/8 hours (even though I took my time with the decorating part), and after this there are no more story elements in the game (unless you forgot some achievements), but you can still obtain some collectables and continue being a decorator.

The style of the game is adorable pixel art, but the decorating mechanics could be more optimized (do not expect Sims levels of freedom) - you can't change the camera angle while decorating, sometimes categories of furniture are confusing, some items can only turn 2 ways, and you can change colours of some items, but not all. You also get some apartments/houses as rewards, to decorate those you need to buy furniture with vouchers (you get them as rewards, it's basically an in-game currency).

In conclusion, I got this game on sale and I'm happy with it, but I'm not sure I would be as happy if I payed the full price. It's a good game, though, a must-play if you're into cozy gaming!
非常解压的休闲独立游戏，玩法简单，纯点击打扫和整理房间、摆放家具、装饰，强迫症患者的福音。像素风，无论是外部小镇还是房屋内部，美术都下足了功夫。“呓语”可谓是含有一丢丢克苏鲁元素，非常适合累了不想战斗换换口味放松一下的时候玩。
fun puzzels, great creative freedom. I would've liked a but more lively interaction with NPC's though
great solo game, calm and relaxing for those who like to organize, clean and interior decorate.

I LOVE this game so much!! So relaxing, beautiful art and everything slots anywhere perfectly! It reminds me a lot of Unpacking but has so much more liberty and more stories to find. Instead of focusing on one life from childhood to adulthood, you go from house to house. It's less of a personal, intimate story and more about discovering the town and its secrets. Each resident has something "mysterious" to them and it's so wonderful to just leisurely walk in the streets and notice this and that isn't where it should be---
很！好！玩！后期支线任务有点重复,不过影响不大。我是真的没想到装修小游戏能有这么多玩法，带一点点微恐小元素，最喜欢的就是烹饪和种花的玩法！！！剧情也很好，玩demo的时候就特别喜欢博士爷爷的那一段剧情。而且游戏还挺短的，10多个小时就可以结束，我打的比较慢嘿嘿，89个成就很多但是也很好集齐，对于我来说真的很好玩！！！！
好玩，就是流程太短了，不知道以后会不会再更新。

Really enjoyed playing this game. Adorable pixel graphics, lots of hidden items, and a small storyline. As you unlock more "jobs" you can purchase different types of furniture in the city mall. Typical "Unpacking" style gameplay with a few freestyle building as well.  This game is simple, cute, and has alot to offer.
a mix of cleaning, house decorating, and an overall whimsiness/mystery surrounding the town. I'm excited to play more and find out what else it has to offer

A dreamy, zen-like house flipping experience set in a manic pixel town full of fascinating interactions and NPCs. Unlike other games of its kind, there's an intimacy to each job that can't really be described, but must instead be experienced. Poetry in pixel form. One of those rare hidden gems where every piece comes together in perfect harmony.

The controls are occasionally finicky on Steam Deck with the default controller layout at present, but it's nothing I'm sure I couldn't fix with some tweaking on my end. Don't pass up this game, it's worth every penny!

I really enjoyed this game. The pixel art is gorgeous, the gameplay is fun, and the storylines are interesting. My main gripe is that I wish there was more!

It's an easy to digest game where you can turn off your thoughts and just decorate pretty rooms, discover secrets, and explore a town. Definitely worthwhile imo.

优点
*主线主打装修+解谜，体验格外有趣，每个任务的需求和风格还各有不同，主线期间绝对不会无聊。很多家具的交互也很用心，小巧思非常可爱。
*不仅仅做了室内的部分，还在小镇本身下了功夫，路上到处都是可交互的物品及探索收集元素，收集元素也不单单需要你瞎跑，而是在小镇报纸上给出线索，对于收集玩家来说非常友好
*自由装修分两类，一个是招募版的主题装修任务，另一个是给自己的屋子随便装修设计，给了你差不多四五套（没数具体多少）不同户型的房子，还有单独存档位，想怎么装怎么装，非常友好了
*很漂亮，不论是家具还是主线都很漂亮
*收集点的交互提示很清楚几乎不会让人无视是很好的设计，可收集元素有49个而游戏内某个*消音*则只需要42个这点也很好，跟着主线正常进行解谜和探索的话这个条件很容易达成更是好中之好。用来购买家具的货币也是根本没缺过，在游戏流程上努力不给玩家使绊子真的难得一见的舒适

缺点
*明明猫元素很多，却不能养
*都是“呓语”小镇了，某些元素却主要存在于主线，装修部件的设计主打还是一个热门正常元素，不够天马行空，虽然不影响体验，但是稍微有点失望（是我擅自期待了.jpg）
*系统操作有亿点繁琐：每个物品染色后可得到的结果色不一样，以至于很难使各个物品达成统一，还不能存储自选颜色；同种物品只能一个一个往外拿，不能选中后一二三四多次拿出来，送的家具包装也是，一个一个往外放不能一键收集回仓库，一个箱子里体感放了几十个家具真是点到昏天黑地；除非叠放不然不能批量挪动；商店购买只能同种东西一次一次买，不能点击加购物车一起购入，在操作上繁琐得有点逆天
*流程还是太短了

但是整体来说还是瑕不掩瑜
one of the best comfort games I found in 2025. I thought would be very simplistic and boring but the story ends up catching you together with the relaxation of gaming
做任务，得钱买各种物品，美化房屋。还可以
I love the story especially the creepy aspect. It's great that most of the time there's no specific rules on how to put the decoration, so I can put it freely where I want.

Det här spelet är ren och skär terapi. 🌿
Att få organisera, inreda och skapa ordning i olika utrymmen är otroligt tillfredsställande, och uppdragen från stadsborna ger spelet både charm och variation. Man hjälper dem att flytta, städa och strukturera sina hem och platser. Varje uppdrag känns genomtänkt och meningsfullt.

Spelet lyckas perfekt med balansen mellan kreativ frihet och tydliga mål, vilket gör att det aldrig känns stressigt – bara mysigt och beroendeframkallande. För mig är detta utan tvekan det bästa spelet jag har spelat inom den här genren. Rekommenderas starkt till alla som gillar organisering, inredning och lugna spelupplevelser.

👍 Rekommenderas varmt.

I am simply obsessed! Whispers of the House is adorable to look at and satisfying to play without getting boring. It is the epitome of a cozy game and totally worth the price! It definitely scratches the itch left behind by Unpacking and leaves me even more satisfied. Hoping the devs include more or put out DLCs for it.
a very cozy game, and it is perfect for someone like me who loves organizing and decorating
SUCH a good game! So relaxing, with a cute style. Anyone who enjoys games with organizing and puzzle would love this game wholeheartedly.

A cozy game that is not a farming game. The gameplay mostly revolves around decorating, but there is also an exploration/puzzle element too. The decorating side of the game is mostly freeform, other than a few story missions will demand you put items in certain places. The puzzles on the whole are not hard, but it does take some dedication to find everything. The Steam achievements can provide hints if you're stuck but still want to figure things out without a walkthrough. I was able to find enough secrets to beat the game in about ten hours this way, and I'll probably still get on from time to time to decorate more show rooms. 

I feel the story is mostly just vibes, but these vibes work well for the game. You could possibly ignore it and focus decorating if you want, but you'll get the most out of this game if you like both the decorating and exploring.

The game is exactly what was promised, which is great!
I'm looking forward to more quests, a new story, and an expanded map. Waiting for DLC!
Where cleaning, organizing and witnessing the creepy can be an addiction.

Super, super cute and easy! There aren't strict rules for how to arrange the furniture so it feels like putting stickers on walls, but it's fun to unlock all the locations and mess around with the atmosphere of the rooms. I especially enjoy the tasty diner and figuring out how to cook dishes.
I loved this game upon my first playthrough. I do feel it has a lot of future potential in updates and patches, but the gameplay was pretty short.
A delightful little game! Recommended for anyone who likes to decorate and organize! If only it were a bit longer.

If you like Unpacking, this is even better and you'll love it. I have been wanting to play this game for awhile now and since playing, I have been having so much fun! The cute pixel art style, the big map you can roam, the cutely animated interactable objects. Everything is so engaging and fun about decorating different rooms with different aesthetics. It doesn't end there too! There is a little bit of lore we get to see between characters or places (I don't want to go into detail about what bc it would be a spoiler) which creates another layer of engagement and makes the game even more interesting. Whisper of the House is a cute, cozy game that is also full of puzzles, interactions, and mini stories that keep you wanting to play more. I definitely got carried away in this one bakery theme house because of the cute food AND **Spoiler Alert** [spoiler] I found out the raw dough can be cooked in the oven if you click on it!! It was such a cute touch and makes the bread all sparkly and a nice golden brown! :D [/spoiler]. I am just having so much fun and have literally recommended this game to everyone I think would like this game too. From the art, music, furniture selection, variety, character stories, and interactability, this game checks all the boxes.

Whisper of the House really scratched the "I need more games like Unpacking" itch! I really like creative freedom this game gives you though - there are so many items to choose from and multiple spaces to make your own! 

The main story is relatively short - I took it pretty slow and it still only took me about 10 hours to complete. I definitely would like more levels and more story to explore, but I'm content with where it's ended for now. Personally, I think I could definitely sink a lot more hours into this game as there are still items I've yet to unlock and spaces I've yet to completely decorate. I also wouldn't mind replaying the levels I've already completed and trying new things!

I highly recommend to those who love decorating games!

Whisper of the House is a great game for those who enjoy pixel graphics, isometric designs, home design, and stress-free gameplay. After playing for a few hours, I really enjoy the game. The controls are easy to get the hang of (which I appreciate as someone who struggles with clunky controls), and the movements are smooth, even on my mid-tier, non-gaming laptop. The storyline of the game is interesting as well. Although I've only played for a few hours so far, I have already discovered secret rooms, corrupted monuments, and even got a phone call from a mysterious figure. The other characters in the game are great, too. I like decorating the rooms, and I can't wait to unlock more items to get increased customization!
温馨，解压，又不失乐趣，而且还有很多小细节，互动满满，以及解密内容，做这个游戏的人是天才！

have been waiting a long time for a game like unpacking... love the added story/personalisation/life sim elements. I like that the devs didnt make these too much to take away from the key of this game.
So cute and cozy love it <3 AND there are free updates, thanks dev team.

интересная игра для того что бы расслабиться, выполняешь задания по обустраиванию комнат, дают небольшой сюжет и "spooky-scary" намеки. единственный минус, о котором говорят и остальные игроки, что тут есть гача на предметы, и порой не сразу понятно где найти той или иной предмет, так как магазинов на карте миллион.
A charming game with a little bit of a mystery to solve, full of cute decorations and interesting characters to meet. I really enjoy the music, and all of the rooms you get to decorate.

This game scratched an itch I've had since I finished Unpacking. It's so satisfying to design both homes and businesses, and I feel like the devs give you a lot of freedom in how you approach the rooms. I appreciate the presets for rooms in your own homes, and also that you get multiple homes to work with. Just playing through and then going back to get all of the achievements, the game took me about 6 hours. I'd say that's well worth the cost. The graphics are lovely and it's such an easy game to spend the whole day on.

I love this game so much!!! Even though the story itself is a little short, it still provides you with endless rooms to decorate and clean, and it's jam packed with secrets and little nuggets of charm. It's officially become my new favourite game, and I cannot recomend it enough!
喜欢这个画风，很细节很有趣，装修配件很丰富，探索的过程也很吸引人
I love this game!!!! I would rate this almost like Unpacking. I wish more stories and missions in the game. Fun game

a quick, easy game. and that's about as far as it goes! i was able to 100% the game in under 8 hours while not rushing whatsoever. i bought the game not knowing the story bc it seemed like unpacking, which i've played front to back multiple times. the story was good, especially considering i didn't know it had some mystery/problem solving elements! it was a pleasant surprise to say the least! but to tell the truth, the ending was wildly lackluster. i quite literally out loud said "that's it?" when i reached the end. it's an easy game, one that's quick to get through and doesn't require much thought other than the decorating portion and if you choose to follow some of the hidden story elements (which i can't recommend you do enough, it was my favorite part.) all in all, it's a fun game with an easy to understand story, but don't have the highest of hopes for a fulfilling ending. fun game though <3

通了《呓语小镇》，核心的装修玩法很推荐👍

不过游戏有很多地方感觉很神秘，属于体验上让人眼前一亮，但实际上又感觉差点火候的感觉……

⭐亮点⭐
1）装修丰富自由，可以塞很多细节满满的杂物
2）装修之外，隐藏元素，小互动和解谜很有意思
3）有自由装修的关卡延长可玩性
4）大地图可以捡垃圾
5）精美的像素美术
6）相比《unpacking》等外国游戏，这个游戏里的装修要素更加通用，对中国玩家来说更好理解和摆放。不至于有些东西看不懂是什么不知道放在哪

🤔见仁见智的部分🤔
1）大地图设计很亮眼，但是实际上利用率不是很高，于是一开始的惊喜带来期待之后，后续实际体验略有落差
2）游戏设计了一些“怪异”和“异常”的元素，这种元素和游戏轻松玩法存在反差，我喜欢是喜欢这种反差的。不过有人可能不能接受任何的怪异元素。
3）基于上一点，我作为喜欢怪异元素的人，我觉得游戏最终对怪异元素的解释太随便和苍白了，让人有种“就这？认真的吗？”的淡淡无语感😂

但总的来说，上述这些见仁见智元素属于额外的添头，并且没有这些添头的话我大概不会玩这款游戏。

至于这些添头是虎头蛇尾草率收场，还是保持高水准完美落幕，其实都不影响核心的装修玩法的稳健。所以整体来说还是个值得推荐的游戏就是了😂
特别喜欢画风，家具和小物件样式很丰富，很容易就能布置出好看的房间。喜欢能和路边各种垃圾和箱子盒子互动的设计。主线的几个小故事都很好，个人最喜欢小鱼的故事。很期待有更多带剧情的任务更新。虽然主线完结之后设定上来讲应该就没有异常了，但是之前寻找异常的机制真的很爽，希望以后有机会更新出更多类似的玩法。

I want a MEH option. I can't give it a full negative because I did end up finishing it and did have a bit of fun, but there are too many cons for me to say THIS IS AN AMAZING GAME, BUY IT like I do my other positives. 

Pros: 
- Cute graphics. (Remind me a bit of a game I played online growing up called Furcadia).
- Different types of interiors to decorate (music stores, plant stores, house-types, etc)
- Different decorating quests ("make my house cutesy, give me a room for all my plushies, etc)
- Fairly decent options for stacking, overlapping, etc

Cons:
- The story. It feels like this started as a decorative game and the creator decided it needed a story, so they put something together, but the pieces don't mesh well. Separately the two would flourish, but squished together, one takes away from the other at times. 
- A lot of the items for decorating are tiny clutter items instead of furniture. Three different types of milk cartons, multiple chip bags, many soda bottles, etc. It's hard to tell what some of them are by looking at them, and there's not a lot of cupboard space for them. 
- The UI when decorating can be frustrating sometimes due to the nature of a 2D game. A fridge can hold multiple items on one shelf, but you have to press TAB to get those items on the back of the shelf where you can't see them.
- The UI for storage can be confusing when looking for a particular type of item. Some items aren't where you would first think they should be and searching can be a bit of a pain.
- The income bit of the game is unbalanced, where you have more money than you'd ever need. You collect the maximum amount of items the game offers you pretty quickly, even when it's random chance with loot boxes, and then whatever money you have left goes toward purchasing side-quests which can vary from detailed requirements to "decorate my room for my plushies!" and you can just throw in a few shelves and slap the toys on them. 
- The side-quests, as mentioned above. Another con with side quests being everything starts to feel the same after a while when you only have so many objects with which to decorate and almost too many side-quests/extra rooms to decorate that look nearly identical.
- There are a few side quests where you don't even choose where the objects go. It just wants you to place them down where there's an outline for them in a pre-determined location.
Es un juego que practicamente da horas infinitas de contenido, me encantaría que pusieran más historia o más cosas pero es maravilloso.

If you enjoy Unpacking but with more story this game is for you. The game has a whole lore behind it which without spoiling too much I can only say that you need to try to play it for yourself to discover. The gameplay concept is essentially similar to Unpacking where you put stuff whereever you want while meeting objectives for the story and I enjoy the cute pixelated style greatly. It has more levels than Unpacking as well and required you to move around to figure stuff out and unlock secrets and puzzles. The differences I wouldf say is that it offers a little more story and puzzles compared to Unpacking, which if that is what you seek then this is recommended for you. It is still cozy and there is no pressure to be "good" at the game or anything like that. Just start, help people moved into their new places, and begin the story and work from there.

If you're a fan of Unpacking, Animal Crossing, The Sims, or any other game that lets you meticulously decorate rooms for hours: this is for you.

I had a fun time with this game. The graphics are pixel perfect, the music is upbeat yet soothing, and the whole vibe is just adorable. There's a very wide variety of rooms and items you can collect/unlock, plus optional side quest where you can decorate rooms effectively from scratch, giving you total freedom in your design choices.

I will say, HowLongToBeat claimed it's 9.5 hours for a completionist run -- I spent twice as long with this game, and I didn't even do half the optional quests. Even at the 9 hour mark, I felt that the game has begun to overstay its welcome. In the first 5-6 hours, it was pure delight, but the thing about this kind of game is that it gets repetitive before long. I've seen quite a few Unpacking fans complain that it's too short at ~6 hours, so WotH might be great for them, but to me Unpacking was exactly the perfect length.

In general, considering this game is heavily based on Unpacking, it's hard to avoid making comparisons. For me, it took most aspects of Unpacking that made it a work of art (the deliberate choice of items and the story told through them, the emotional highs and lows of the journey without a single word of dialogue) and tossed them out in favor of making it 'gamier': there's an overworld map, a level up system, an item catalogue for you to collect, a gacha system, characters that give you quests... while it's certainly interesting to see WotH take things in a different direction, I ultimately don't believe the trade-off was worth it.

WotH does have its own story, or rather, a lot of tiny stories for the characters whose houses you decorate, but they're all very shallow, quirky, and often silly. The game doesn't expect you to take it too seriously, which is fine, but I did find the story often too wacky and out there for me to enjoy. Unpacking's emotional, down-to-earth overarching story definitely engaged me more.

Overall, I do recommend this game, but I don't believe it surpasses its inspirations. Nonetheless, I enjoyed my time with it, even if I felt it stretched a bit long.

[u] Pros; [/u]

[u] Nitpicks/Cons; [/u]

整体玩法和前期故事节奏相当有趣，前期打到医院线之间，几乎每个主线NPC的委托和故事都挺有趣，属于是温馨感人。而且能通过清洁打扫+解密达成对NPC人生的改变，见证他们的重要时刻，整体挺有趣。很像unpacking那个游戏，但是更丰富多彩，小镇本身也有自己的主线BALABALA这里就不赘述了。虽然中后期几乎是烂尾，但还是值得一玩。
缺点：
1、中后期基本烂尾节奏稀烂，做到黑手党-医院-墓地任务环节，博物馆倒计时显示还有十来天，主线和进度几乎停滞，只能干站着等倒计时。中后期的日常样板房任务几乎全部是重复的，万卷书、直播间、回到童年这几个几乎是无限循环，有点搞头的只有钓鱼佬、动漫社、学生的秘密基地那几个算是有点新鲜感。到后面都不想接日常任务了。
2、地图系统设计得有点莫名其妙，因为小镇中大部分有常驻NPC的建筑不开放，其他开放的全是任务中去过的地方，地图很小没什么可逛。但是在码头那边又有NPC头顶冒感叹号可以接中华街餐厅的任务，然而地图上又毫无显示，只有自己逛街过去才能看到。不太明白这地图存在有啥用。
3、经济系统在做主线任务之后几乎是全够的，经验和日常任务给的钱除了无限刷家具/书籍/家电盲盒几乎没用，亲测在商店全收集了身上还有1W多花不出去。玩到后期几乎在摆烂，每天街头翻垃圾罚站，然后等天黑了回房间睡觉等博物馆倒计时。
4、小镇上空房子很多，给了主角好几套房子，但是意义不明。显示上好像每一个都是主角的家可以随便装修，但是没办法指定哪一个是主角常驻的房间。后期我全力装修了一套面积最大靠近墓地的那一套，但是NPC送礼的礼盒依然在主角初始房间。几套房子的装修只有一两套是能切换房型，其他都不能改变面积格局。不明白这种设计的意义是什么，给玩家多几次自由发挥的空间？但是做到后期几乎整个小镇都是主角的房子感觉非常诡异……干嘛……我来这不是传奇清洁工而是地产大亨来了……

Quando terminei Unpacking, achei que nunca mais ia encontrar um jogo desse estilo. Whisper of the House é, e vai além. 

Um jogo para quem gosta de organização, oferece um catálogo de customização e uma história fofa (que ainda estou conhecendo). Você precisa cumprir missões na cidade onde foi morar, e cria conexões com os moradores. Pode andar pela cidade, visitar lugares onde já trabalhou como organizador/decorador, customizar sua própria casa e cuidar da limpeza da cidade. As missões seguem uma ideia parecida com a de House Flipping, mas é mais num estilo cozy e pixelado. 

Estou extremamente feliz com a compra e descoberta deste jogo. Infelizmente acho que vou zerar em pouco tempo. Única coisa que poderia fazer o jogo ser ainda melhor seria a cidade abrigar os jogadores e poder interagir online. 

Recomendo demais para quem gosta de jogos no estilo cozy e de organização.

This is a very colorful game. It has so much stuff in it and a cute little story and characters. They've added levels and places to decorate. The decorating feels satisfying as well as the cleaning.

But what I REALLY dont like is how you get furniture. You have to unlock everything in loot boxes before they appear in the stores. They give you a way to get rid of any furniture you dont want. But that becomes an exhausting feat because the loot boxes WILL give you repeats. The inventory ends up feeling way too cluttered for my liking , all in the pursuit of seeing all that there could be to decorate with. I have 40 hours in this game. I enjoy the experience it has to offer, especially if you like simply point and click games.

But it does make me sad that you have to use the loot boxes to get decoration. It makes the process so much harder. The categories in the inventory are great. It does help somewhat for finding things. But i don't want to scroll forever, sifting through items i dont want because I can't avoid repeats.

先说结论：整体不错，期待后续更新。（但是我是更擅长挑刺的，可能缺点会明显多很多....）
一：优点：
1.画风我超爱的
2.主线剧情或者说是人物塑造方面蛮不错的。一方面用信件和装修前后寥寥几句对话，另一方面用房间家具的介绍，就描绘出各自的人物特色。很难不让人感叹这小镇真是“神人”辈出啊（bushi）以及大家是真的有房子真送啊
3.除了装修搞大扫除的主线，还穿插了一些其他小游戏，比如培育花种，调酒，今日塔罗牌和新加的做菜。
4.主线奖励（包括升职奖励）给得很大方，基本不需要做单独的额外随机日常就能抽盒子把所有的家具抽到手（包括更新后的家具）（不排除有人真的特别脸黑）
二：缺点：
1.太短了，剧情线实在太短了：
 （1）.主线短得要命，加上全成就我也就10个小时就打完了，还是更新后的加了两个房间的情况下，就算打折后40让我感觉有点难受了。只不过有好几个异常倒也查了攻略就是。
 （2）.装修支线几乎没有。对我来说，主线就是金字塔博物馆里的所有异常。从这方面来讲，冬季更新前的所有内容基本上除了每日随机主题装修任务，就只剩主线了。
2.感觉地图上有很多非常鲜明特色的我应该可以去的建筑，都去不了也没有任务。举个最明显的例子，那个警察局，占地面积又大欸，看起来又这么重要一建筑，但是就一点儿任务不给我发。希望是还没更新，而不是真的纯摆设。嘶，打完字想起再举个例子，我们镇长怎么滴也该有个办公室给我装修装修吧？ 
3.太少了。家具实在是太少了。小件花样（特别是两个便利店贡献了超多牌子货×）还算多，但是大件真的少。
 （1）.种类少。摆桌上的台灯就一两款，连个横着的笔直笔直一根线的LED灯都没有；衣柜只有一整扇一大饼整个关上的，没有那种半衣柜半置物架类型的； 连厕所卷纸都只有已经挂卷纸筒上的一种！！！！能不能给个没有挂卷纸筒上的卷纸让我直接摆平台上啊！！！（以及还有蛮多的，但是我已经删游戏了还在打测评呢，懒得退出去重新下了×
 （2）.染色少。从种类少上衍生出来的怨念。如果种类多的话，染色少不能说不是缺点，但是也不会这么引人注目。举个例子：做完主线折腾完新的图鉴，就想拿家装修个红白圣诞风，结果打开那个被子和床单嗷，一个都不能染色。我又不想用圣诞套的纯白雪花，哥特套又是个黑红太刺眼，还有个橙红条纹的又看着有点老.....真的给我装修得恶心到了。就不能让我用圣诞套染个深红底白雪花的被子吗·？？
三：建议：虽然只是建议还不到缺点，但是说实话也是让我玩得有点恶心的方面了。
1.染色，一定要有统一的度量衡。这染色受家具底色影响。家具都先不提了，那个地板墙壁啊，有时候我想搞拼接花样都不行，因为怎么调两款地板都调不到同一个颜色，看着真的蛮膈应的。
2.求求调酒来点游戏内的提示，能耐心自己调出来的都是佬，是真大佬。而我又没有耐心又不懂酒，一想到挨个1+1试了还要1+1+1的试就想吐，至少给个提示一种混合酒要几种酒混合吧（最后还是靠佬们的攻略收集完的）
3.新出的做菜系统好像没有给个托盘啥的能一次性带出好几种菜吧？给个吧，让我做点预制菜吧，不然一进一出的实在有点消耗眼睛消耗做菜热情了。
4.家具能不能给个标签TAT，有些明显是一整套（一整个类型）的家具，比如中式家具，和风家具，圣诞节家具，活力橘子家具等，因为各个家具名字没统一，部分家具名称特立独行，也没个统一标签，导致关键词查找也很难找全。只能说，很难受。
再次总结：虽然我叨叨了一大篇的缺点和建议，但是你说我玩的时候开不开心，倒也真的蛮开心的。整个主线流程玩下来顺滑又舒适，但是主线完了就空虚下来了，缺点也层层浮现。如果游戏后续能继续优化完善，也能称得上是一份不错的作品。

Whisper of the House is a charming, quirky, polished and thoroughly captivating game that will bring players hours or even days of entertainment and fun, with a solid helping of added mystery to the brew. 

You play as a newcomer to a small town who is hired by various townspeople to decorate their houses. That's the basic game. You go from job to job, sorting out characters' houses as well as their problems. As the game progresses, the tasks become more complex but you'll also find more weird things happening. The town has mysteries and secrets. The overall goal of the game is to find everything hidden and unravel what's really going on in the town. 

You can also freely wander the city streets at any time of the day or night and find item vouchers (sparkling spots on the ground), go through trash for items, pet cats (so many cats and my favourite thing to do in the game), fix or clean up things, talk to townspeople (always talk more than once as what they say does change and some of it is important), make cocktails, grow plants, collect a jaw-dropping number of decoration objects, find abandoned houses to fix up, get job requests off the bulletin board and just explore. It's not a full 'open world' game. The town has  an outer boundary but you can go anywhere within it. You will find a lot of things of interest and also a number of anomalies that need to be fixed to progress through the game. 

This is a game that's both very relaxed and yet intense at the same time. There is no time limit on anything with the exception of at least one event that the townsfolk will tell you a rumour about. The rumour includes the time that it happens each night, but if you're earlier or later you can still see it, so even that isn't as urgent as it appears to be. In this game, you play entirely at your own pace. There is a clock and a day/night system, but all of that can be ignored. New mail arrives at 6am daily but you'll always get a notification about it anyway. So you can rush through the game or take your time with it, whatever pace suits you. 

Speaking of no timer, the numbers on the museum are not time-related. When they get to 00 the game doesn't automatically end or anything dramatic like that. It just means you've played enough of the game to reach the final scene and solve the town's final mystery. If you're not ready for that, you can keep doing what you need/want to do until you are. This is a rare game with absolutely no rush factor. 

Some people say the game took them 8 hours to finish. it's certainly possible to finish the core plot line in that time. It took me 20 hours and I've only finished the main story. I still have a few things to finish off. Also related to how long the game will take you, the town is not so small that you won't get lost if you forget there's a map function. I forgot about it until about 4/5 of the way into the game, which explains a lot of my extended gametime for a single run-through. The rest was spent exploring the town and enjoying rather a lot of cat petting. The little interaction pop-up on the screen of the cat being petted is adorable. 

However you play this game, you'll get an incredible experience. The plot runs deep, but it all comes together very satisfyingly. The journey is much of the fun in that. The characters you'll meet are full of personality and quirkiness and most of them are very nice. For players who get invested in game characters emotionally, expect to come out of this feeling like you've made a whole game cast of new friends. The jobs are a big part of that as they showcase the characters, their livestyles and their dreams for the future. This is the true heart of the game and it's especially warm and cosy.

That said, fair warning for mentioned character deaths and two of the jobs that relate to them. They've been very compassionately worked into the game but the hospital and graveyard jobs may make some players sad. If you're not good with scary scenes, added warning for the graveyard and graveyard tower jobs. Although the graveyard job also has some humour to counter the location's original vibes.

The music is very well done all through this. For every job, you'll receive a record as a reward that works as both a wall decoration and a playable record. Unless you get one earlier, you may need to wait until near the end of the game before you can play them, though. I didn't get the record player until it came as a reward for one of the later jobs.

The game has achievements and most of them will be earned through a normal play-through of the game. It's possible to earn all of them in a single play-through (I did), but only if you at least look up the list of achievements before you play, because some achievements require you to do things that you wouldn't normally think of doing. There are achievement guides available if you need them. There are also guides for the secret drink (7) and plant growing (8) recipes, although you can work through all of the options logically if you want to do it all yourself. 

Overall, I found this game to be a truly enjoyable, fun and relaxing experience. Every part of it has been crafted with obvious dedication to making a good time for the players, no matter their play style. It would be especially enjoyable for anyone who likes a bit of mystery with their cosy, character-driven games, or who enjoys finding hidden game things for themselves (although there are guides available). My one disappointment with this game was that the map does not show the locations of all pettable cats. I think I found them all. Hopefully anyone else who plays this game will enjoy it as much as I have.

玩法上，游戏核心是扮演小镇家政工，完成居民的各种收纳、装修委托。但与同类游戏不同，本作的核心乐趣不仅在于把物品摆放整齐，更在于通过整理窥探居民的生活与秘密。而且游戏中埋藏着大量悬疑线索和解谜要素，让收纳过程充满探索感！同时游戏没有硬性摆放标准，自由度极高，完美满足了“强迫症”的整理欲望。

画风与音效上，采用色彩柔和、细节丰富的像素风格，营造出温馨梦幻的小镇氛围；几乎所有物品都可互动且有细腻音效，增强了沉浸感~

缺点就是流程太短啦！！希望后续会有持续更新~

TL;DR: Cute little game, but has its issues. Short, but you can keep decorating after the game "ends" if you want and the plot isn't doing a whole lot anyways. definitely did not feel like a puzzle, and calling it a "mystery" is a bit of a stretch because it implies there's something to solve

SYNOPSIS:
so, first of all, i enjoyed this game. if you like sims build mode, unpacking or any other item placement/design games, you'll like the designing portion. the items in it are cute, there's a bunch of different spaces to decorate, and lots of different personalities you can give to a room with different sets and stuff. plot relevant character spaces contain little secrets to be found, which is fun. i wish it was a little longer, and i felt a little lost at the end when the mail stopped coming, because i wasn't sure if there was more or if i was "done" (with the exception of the end portion, which is kind of separate.) That being said, the pacing/length, tone, and inventory management leave a bit to be desired - which isn't actually a dealbreaker for me because i wasn't here for the plot anyways.

PACING: 
the plot is largely paced out by in-game time passing. Because in-game time does not pause while you are decorating, several "days" can pass while you work on a design. A new day means new mail, which brings new hints and new jobs, so it almost feels like you are being rushed by new things showing up before you're even done the thing you're working on

it's bizarre to feel *rushed* in a game where the total gameplay is only 5-10 hours - the game could easily have been a little longer if they paced it out slightly slower and made the noticeboard commissions more necessary to make money and "fill time" while waiting for new stuff to show up with the next day. (there is a built in "sleep" function that could be used for those who do not want to "kill time" on the noticeboard commissions, but this is a game ABOUT DECORATING, why would you want to skip the decorating?) 

As it is, you make enough in-game currency to unlock most/all items in the game by completing the main plot and wandering around the town, so you never actually *have* to take on those commissions. you also never *have* to use the sleep function because the days pass by so fast in the background

TONE: 
i fully acknowledge that this might just be a translation/localization thing, but the character plots were simple, and there wasn't a lot of interesting dialogue. You only really meet each character once or maybe twice, and then you are finished with them. if each story had contained one more beat, they would have felt much more satisfying. 

this game wants to be mysterious and creepy SO badly, but it kind of misses that mark and falls into cheesy (with the possible exception of the haunted tower, which felt about as creepy as a pixel graphic game could get.) mostly, they drop some "ominous" hints throughout, but there's never really much to puzzle out or theorize about. it's just kind of generic 'something weird is happening in our town' until the very end, at which point they "reveal" what's going on, but it's not satisfying. mostly just feels like a lore dump to fill in the blanks. 

INVENTORY/QUEST MANAGEMENT: 
game inventory items are unlocked via gacha boxes with in-game currency, and there are several different collections of items (furniture/textiles/appliances/food&drink/decor) which each have two vendors - one for the gacha part, and one to purchase extra "copies" of gacha items you've already discovered. 

There are 3 different "types" of decorating:

1. Moving a plot relevant character into a space 
- Advances the story (+ a reward of in-game currency and special items)
- Has specific items that need to be used in the room, occasionally even specific places those items need to go.
- Each room has tasks that need to be completed. Once those tasks are complete you can "finish" a room, but you are able to "finish" a room without finding all of the relevant anomalies in that location (which is a headache later, because you have to find all the anomalies to get to the end of the game, and some of them might be in rooms you've already "finished" - hope you like to backtrack through every house in town looking for anomalies!) 
- would love each room to be a little bit bigger or have the ability to move some of the existing features, so that there were more "choices" in the design. the rooms being small enough that things can only "go" in so many ways is what makes this a "puzzle" i guess. 

2. Decorating a space on behalf of a client (perfect, no notes)
- Optional commissions picked up on the notice board (reward is in-game currency) 
- Use items in your inventory, paint the walls, change the floors etc. 
- Client provides a few key items that need to be involved in the space, but the rest is up to you 
- inventory shows all items that you have unlocked, and you can use as many of each item as you want (if you've unlocked "shell lamp" you can place 47 shell lamps if that's your heart's desire)

3. Decorating spaces you "own" (most annoying by far)
- start with one space that belongs to you, but unlock others through game advancement 
- Use items in your inventory, paint the walls, change the floors etc. 
- Inventory only shows items that you currently "have" and items are limited in quantity based on how many you have pulled (for example: if you've unlocked "shell lamp" and you have pulled 1 shell lamp, you can place it once, and then you no longer have a shell lamp visible in your inventory until you either pull another or go to the mall to purchase one.) I found this frustrating, because it meant i could not actually see all the options of what i could put in my house - would have liked to see the items but have them greyed out or something
- extra copies of unlocked items can be purchased at the mall, but you must walk your character over to the mall and interact with different vendors for each type of item. (if you are designing a room and you realize you only have one of the chair you want to use, you have to exit out of the designer window, walk over to the mall, talk to the furniture vendor, and scroll through their wares to find the thing you want to buy - and if you're not sure which vendor will sell the thing you want? too bad, scroll through all of them) - it's so cumbersome. why can't i just purchase more of an item directly through my inventory?!?

IN CONCLUSION: 
the designing portion is definitely worth playing if you like that type of game, but if you're looking for a "mystery" or even a "puzzle" you'll be disappointed

Com um cenário interativo e cheio de detalhes, é fácil perceber o quanto o [b] GD Studio [/b] coloca carinho em seus projetos - visível em cada pixel e linha de código. Isso, na minha opinião, torna o jogo profundo e cria uma atmosfera acolhedora, que faz o jogador se sentir parte daquela história.

Joguei por 10 horas até platinar, e com certeza vou continuar por muito mais tempo graças ao alto fator de replay. Mesmo após o fim da história principal, a rejogabilidade permanece praticamente intacta - o jogo parece te chamar para continuar explorando, testando cores, mobílias e combinações de decoração. É [i] surrealmente [/i] divertido e relaxante.

A couple of things I didn't really like:
- The decorating feels kind of limited. You can't change the color of most items and the color selection is very limited, even with the color picker tool. You can't really mess with saturation all that much and some colors come out very bright or very dark.

- Almost all the bathrooms were absolutely tiny so you are very limited to how much detail you can put in them. You can't even change the shape of your bathroom and are stuck with the walk in shower set up.

-The ending felt a little disappointing but it does wrap everything up nicely. So it wasn't a bad ending just a bit anti-climatic.

*SPOILERS*

I absolutely ADORE cozy games (and more so when they've got a little kick to them). Whisper of the House (WotH) is a charming and cute indie pixel art game where you work as an interior designer by helping clients settle in the town. But that aside, you also notice over time how some tidbits look and feel unusual and mysterious - creepy, even. 

Comparing this to Unpacking is a disservice to both games! While both are about making a home, WotH feels more free; in a sense that the player can place whatever they want wherever. Not only do you get to decorate people's houses as well, but also your own! It's an optional side that you can do with an extra feature of gacha on furniture by using "tickets" you get from completing missions and rummaging through trash (which is the best part of the game fr)

In comparison to Unpacking, WotH feels more episodic. It places value in each client's personal story through the way they want their home decorated in contrast to Unpacking where you only really look at only one person's life. Despite this difference, both games are outstanding in their own right and both WotH AND Unpacking are very deserving of praise for its cozy, comforting, and zen vibe.

Overall, this game is wonderful and if you're an avid cozy game enjoyer for room designing w really good graphic and visual design like me, you are sure to love experiencing this game as much as I did. Easiest 9/10!

A very cute pixel organizing game similar to "Unpacking", albeit with a background Christian bent, where "Unpacking" was made by a Jewish developer and had Jewish elements (which is unfortunately rather unique in the video game space). That being said, "Whisper of the House" was a bit more enjoyable than "Unpacking" in some ways, in that the quests were quite fun, it didn't crash (though it had a number of lag issues that looked like near-crashes), and it identified objects for the player to move around. It's also a little longer and there's more stuff to do, although that made it a bit overwhelming at times, and I think the game is more targeted at people who like to make cute house designs than people who just like organizing things.

One of my main criticisms of "Unpacking" was that I didn't know what all the objects you handle were, so it was hard to figure out which room was the correct one for them. Although "Whisper of the House" generally sticks you in the right room for whatever object you're given (with the option of switching rooms as needed, though this is rarely necessary outside personal desire), the game also not only names whatever the object is, but also describes it. The descriptions aren't always useful, but the naming is.

There are issues with near-crashing: whenever a character would I think leave a screen, the screen would go entirely black, and the game would very obviously lag. During the end cutscene, the game froze, and then jumped a couple seconds forward. I also recall dealing with leg on clicking things at times (particularly with the gacha stuff), which was frustrating. While I appreciate the game is self-contained and has no microtransactions while containing gacha design elements, like games like "Vampire Survivors", I found this pretty aggravating because it does the "Kirby and the Forgotten Land" thing, where you can get repeat items rather than drawing from a narrower pool. This was irritating in "Astro Bot" as well, where you could spend hard-earned money to buy junk instead of items from the remaining pool. Considering just how many items there are in the game and how many pulls you have to do on average for them, it's very silly that you can collect things you already have when doing pulls, especially when it has no microtransactions so there's no intelligent reason to keep people making pulls, other than that's just how gacha tends to work.

The pixel art is very cute, and I appreciated the slight "Stardew Valley" and "Gravity Falls" vibes, with plenty of clear love for Studio Ghibli. The game does feel a bit overwhelming in moments, with a fast day-to-night cycle (that admittedly doesn't do anything other than matter for I think one item), and a small deluge of quests you get at once, until you discover everything is basically optional and the map has a pin system so you can set markers for yourself to go to if you get lost. The freedom and sense of narrative is nice, but I did appreciate "Unpacking"'s more linear narrative.

I was also really confused, from a narrative angle, why the game keeps giving you [spoiler]homes to live in. By the time the ending rolled around, I'd gotten a handful of places to live in, on top of living rent free(?) in two different apartments, so I was a bit confused why I was meant to be excited about being gifted a house and too much stuff to stick in it, cute as the furniture is[/spoiler]. This is why I pointed out that the game seems more geared towards folks who like rearranging pretty fake houses than folks who like organizing, because this game design aspects seems to be geared towards giving the former more of what they want. And that's great for the former, but a bit underwhelming if you're not as into that part and just want puzzle-solving. I'm also a bit disappointed [spoiler]we didn't get to have a pet. The mysterious dog is never explained, and we don't get to keep the cat(s) that are wandering around. But I did appreciate the aquarium[/spoiler]. Additionally, while the town is nice, [spoiler]it's mostly empty. So the town aspect (rather than just focused on building to building, as "Unpacking" does) felt a bit wasted, since most of the neat-looking buildings and areas aren't places you can visit[/spoiler]. I also wish there were more buildings with [spoiler]people showing you where to put things. I get it defeats the purpose for some stuff, but it was satisfying in its own way[/spoiler].

From a designer point, storage was also quite irritating. The [spoiler]present boxes are very cute, for instance, but you can neither store nor even trash them, so they just filled up my basement[/spoiler].

It was also very weird to find [spoiler]when you click the cop car, whoever's in it says "Comrade", like... the  pigs are communists? I'm so confused. I also wonder why a police station that serves no purpose (other than removing an unhoused person off-screen) was more important than other town facilities, like a dump or a school[/spoiler].

This can also be very hard on your hands, given some segments require continuous clicking. "Gemporium" actually had an accessibility feature for this, allowing a single button press to replace multiple ones. It was frustrating not to see that here.

Generally, though, it's a simple little game, with cute designs and fun puzzles. If you liked "Unpacking", you'll probably like this. If you liked this, you should try "Unpacking".

I DEFINITELY recommend this game if you're looking for that Unpacking feeling - but I'll go even further and say: to me this game is better in so many ways. (but also very different and with a different purpose! not trying to say Unpacking isn't good, just stating my preference here!)

- First of all, the art is absolutely adorable and straight-up beautiful.
- You can walk around the map and interact with things in the city. It's so fun and the city isn't too big so it's not a bother to go from one place to another.
- You get requests from residents to clean or/and renovate their home or their work place, from duplex to bakery, flower shop, magic atelier... There's a good variety of places to decorate, you'll never get bored.
- There's no restriction when decorating, which means you place the items wherever you want!
- The stories of the residents are entertaining and cute. I wasn't expecting anything special but I was honestly surprised to find myself enjoying them and the humor of the game is all cute and giggles too.
- Daylies and side stories! And a newspaper system that gives you hints about them every day!
- There's mystery to solve in the story! It makes you want to discover more and gives the game a little more liveliness.
- There's a lot of items to unlock. The catalog of items is well-balanced. Having to buy them doesn't feel frustrating either because you get "money" pretty easily after a while anyway. If you like to 100% your games, don't worry, you'll be able to. Not too easily but not hard to achieve either!
- You get your own home to decorate as you wish, loved that part. And you don't HAVE to do it either, it doesn't change anything to the main story whether you do it or not so you can just skip it if you prefer to focus on the residents.
- You can enter any place you previously decorated and decorate it again. I never did it but I thought it nice.

Overall, I spent around 15-16 hours to complete the game and oh I wished it never ended! I absolutely loved it and I hope there'll be a new one, or at least a DLC.
I do think some details could've been better here and there (more variety in the OSTs and the ability to rotate all items 360°) but honestly, with the game being so good AND cheap, I'm not complaining about it at all. I honestly wasn't expecting that much content in the first place.

If you're hesitating to give it a try, please just go for it. This is easily one of the best decorating games ever! (at least to me :))

This is a really cozy organization and decorating game. I enjoy just how many items the game has to offer for decorating and how spacious the rooms feel. I think for it's price it's certainly worth it if you're wanting a cozy organization game, so I can't not recommend it.

However, I do have a few gripes about this game. First off, there's sort of a story happening, but it's rather unclear and the main quests I was getting through the mail just kind of stopped at some point without any fan fair or explanation as to why? I assume I just ran out of quests, but I would have thought it would be a little bit clearer about it, such as giving me end credits or saying it was the final quest. Maybe I'm not actually done, but I've spent another hour or so in the game and haven't gotten any more quests so I am unsure ahah. It seems weird to me to establish a system for playing the game and then abandon it. And the mystery is till pretty much unknown to me?

When it comes to the levels, I enjoyed them, tho some of the items seemed a bit too cluttery (leaving me a little stressed as to how/where I'm supposed to put some of them as a lot of the levels aren't given space for the clutter - such as one of the house levels gives you a bunch of kitchen items but there is only like 3 counter spaces and there aren't any drawers or shelves to put things into), or the levels seemed too structured, where they would just tell you where to put items or give you items that very clearly have set spots they would fit best, such as the shelves in the convenience store. I just would have liked to see a little more thought in some places to make it feel like we had more freedom.

I also don't enjoy that only some items are customizable color wise, and it's not clear which items are and are not until you put them down and try. For example, there are counters that you can change the color for, but the sink version of that counter can't be changed, so it won't match if you change the color. I would love some clarity in the game, maybe an icon or something next to the item that just says it's dyable. I think this is because the button to customize and the button to interact is the same, so for the sink when you interact it just turns the water on, but it's still a bit frustrating. 

There are a few other minor things that I didn't love about the game, and I will say that I am a little disappointed since everybody in the reviews has been raving about how good/interesting the story is and how fun the gameplay is, and I'm not sure it quite lives up to that, but it is a fun game and I'm hoping to play a bit more, in hopes of understanding the mystery/story. There are also a lot of things that I think this game does well!

This game scratches an itch I didn't even know I had. 

I love games with creative elements, especially when you have your own base or room to organize and design in some way. A lot of games have this now, but it's rarely ever part of the core game play. Then you have other games where creativity and design *are* part of the core game play, but those tend to feel more like casual sandboxes.

This game figured out how to do both in a way that feels like a creative sandbox that's also engaging and objective-based, with an intriguing mystery unfolding at the same time. One minute, you're cleaning and organizing a house for a new tenant. The next minute, you stumble upon a secret [spoiler] alchemy workshop where you learn how to mix a potion to traverse the astral plane into another dimension [/spoiler]. You know, standard decorating stuff. 

The library of items to decorate with is very large (much more than vanilla SIms these days). There are several themed sets that can all be mixed and matched to your hearts desire. You purchase items from shops via "mystery boxes" that contain a mix of common and rare items. So, it's a little tricky to get a full matching set right away, but you can recycle items you don't want for currency, and there are many ways to get more money to buy more stuff, or even to find new items out in the world. 

No objective is ever exactly the same. It's a very engaging experience. The world is immersive. The attention to detail is [chef's kiss]. The sound design and music are great. This game is a new favorite genre of mine, and it's in a league of it's own. I really hope they add to it with DLC or make a sequel in the future. For now, I'm enjoying the heck of this.

个人角度可以打九分，一份扣在让制作组不要骄傲多多更新。
推荐给所有整理收纳类游戏爱好者。
Game is super immersive, hopefully more content coming soon. Only got about 12 hours of game play and was wishing for more. Id pay good money for DLC. I enjoyed it very much.

75% decorating, 25% walking around and clicking on things. A couple of satisfying discoveries. One or two somewhat challenging puzzles. Mostly easy. Very light. Very short. Did I have fun? Yes, kinda. Is the game well done? Yes, it's charming and cozy. Will I remember this game 5 years from now? Not sure.

But most importantly, would I recommend this game? Yes, but not to everyone. If you want a challenge, don't buy it. If you want a chill sims-like game with a sprinkle of mystery, then go for it!

整体画风非常可爱，像素风温暖又治愈，但在温馨的画面下却隐藏着细思极恐的剧情，让人玩起来既放松又充满好奇心。游戏里有一些微微恐怖的元素和 meta 设计，给人一种“游戏和现实在对话”的感觉，主线任务也有棕色箭头指引，不会让新手迷路，同时可以和小镇上的路人互动，增加了不少生活气息。

装修系统是我最喜欢的部分。家具种类丰富，摆放自由度高，可以随心打造属于自己的房间，哪怕是小细节也能尽情布置。打扫和整理环节也很有趣，大部分垃圾或物件点击？会有标红提示会有红色提示标注，但有些小物件（比如水渍或微小垃圾）由于体积过小，得找半天。

剧情部分算是有点矛盾的体验。开头时主线紧凑，穿插着零碎的文本和细节，吊足了我的胃口。但没过多久，主线就突然“戛然而止”，让我一度以为是不是漏掉了某个触发条件。部分支线和解谜环节的逻辑也显得有点突兀，比如暗室里的人物来去莫名其妙。不过还没玩的时候我没想到会有微恐的剧情，刚出现的时候真的让我惊喜了一下。

在探索和互动方面，《呓语小镇》还是有不少可圈可点的地方。自由探索小镇的时候，总能发现一些小彩蛋，比如随机出现的猫咪、垃圾桶里的小物件、甚至是一些让人忍俊不禁的对话。虽然有些 NPC 的台词确实比较“空”，甚至给人一种氛围大于内容的感觉，但整体上，这种“白天跑任务，晚上瞎逛小镇”的体验还是挺放松的。尤其是和大地图上的隐藏成就结合起来，那种走两步路就能发现新东西的感觉，让探索过程不至于单调。

美术和音效也很好。像素画风看久了也不会腻；互动音效设计得很到位，家具摆放、垃圾清理的声音都有一种莫名的满足感。加上音乐氛围的烘托，整体代入感还算不错。

不过总的来所，《呓语小镇》是一款有潜力的游戏。它不像大制作那样完善，但在玩法融合、氛围营造和细节表现上都能看出诚意。我觉得花五十块钱体验这份治愈与神秘的结合，并不算亏。希望制作组能继续打磨，让这座小镇真正成为一个值得长期停留的地方。
Figuring things out isn't a drag its fun. finding mysteries leaves you feeling fulfilled. Putting things right in their place is nice.

Other than that though, the graphics are cute, the story is cute, and it hits the collectathon and cozy vibes I was looking for.

很萌的一个游戏，对于喜欢装修的人来说很爽。虽然主线比较短，但是有解锁的房子和样板房，这次还上架了一些新家具，解锁了更多调色，制作组还是在听玩家意见的，希望以后定期也会更新，推荐

I'm so glad I found this little gem - what a fantastic and cosy play! The gorgeous pixel graphics are to die for, the world is charming, full and a genuine pleasure to explore. The decorating mechanics are deep and enchanting, with freedom of creativity as well as little puzzles to solve if you care to spend long enough digging around in each build. 

The collecting mechanics for furniture and items is intuitive and exciting, each time I unlock something new I can't wait to run back to one of my houses to redecorate around a new theme! The "jobs" are all unique and different in their own way too so that each build feels special and fresh, with so many different themes to explore. It feels really special to be able to walk into the shops you've helped design and then buy items from them too. The world feels so full and alive. 

The spooky/mystery undertone catches me off guard sometimes but honestly I would accept more of it, the cosiness of the game with the underlying hauntings is such a fun juxtaposition - I'm not quite finished with the game yet as far as I can tell I still have a few jobs to go - so I'm really excited to see what else there is to discover. I get genuinely a little freaked out at some parts (spoiler) like the spooky letters you get in the mail! But it's delightfully spooky in a sense that I want to receive more.

The devs also recently included an update that makes the UI of decorating so much easier by having the items easier to find in your storage/catalogue which honestly made it even more charming to play.

The one criticism I would have is that there's no way to customise your character past the two predetermined options - I would love to be able to wear the clothes that you can unlock or even just change the hair and skin tone would add so much to the game in my opinion!

However, that aside, this game is an easy 10/10 and I'm having so much fun with it. I will be devastated when I complete it. It's a gem!

¡"Whisper of the House" es un juegazo! Si te va el rollo de los juegos tranquilos y creativos, te va a encantar.

Básicamente, tu trabajo es ir a casas de un pueblo a limpiar y decorar. Pero no es solo eso, porque puedes mover y organizar todo como tú quieras. Y no te imaginas la cantidad de muebles y objetos que hay, ¡es una pasada!

Lo mejor es que tiene un estilo pixel art súper bonito y es increíblemente relajante. Además, a medida que juegas, vas descubriendo los secretos del pueblo, lo que le da un toque de misterio genial.

En serio, si buscas un juego para desconectar y crear cosas bonitas, este es. ¡Muy recomendado!

Além de corar, adorei explorar a cidade, descobrir os mistério e principalmente me envolver com os personagens. Depois de jogá-lo por 13 horas, eu ainda estava ansiando por mais conteúdo rsrs.

Just a wonderful little game with so much heart and creativity put into it. I've been itching for another cozy interior design game ever since playing Unpacking, and this one caught me off guard with just how fun and charming and beautiful it is. I had an absolute blast, and I can't recommend it enough for folks who like this type of game. Just wonderful.
Super fun & cozy, an easy recommend to those who love decorating & pixel art.

Whisper of the House is such a cozy little gem. The cute game design immediately drew me in, and the combination of relaxing music and the gentle weather system makes it the kind of game you can unwind with after a long day. It really scratches that Unpacking itch, but with a touch of mystery layered in to keep things interesting.

The recent updates to the furniture UI are a huge improvement — browsing and selecting items feels way more efficient and user friendly now, which makes the whole decorating process even smoother and more enjoyable. The replayability is also surprisingly solid thanks to the daily showrooms, which are perfect for those moments when you just want that quick, satisfying “one room” hit without committing to a full session.

If you’re looking for something wholesome, chill, and a little intriguing, Whisper of the House is absolutely worth your time.

ドット絵がすごい可愛い！！

ストーリーの依頼は決められた家具を配置していくけど、そのほかの家は自由に家具を選んで配置できるので、ストーリーが終わっても楽しめる要素がある。


ストーリー依頼は物を並べるだけでもクリアできるので、苦手な人でもクリアできます・・・。

Excellent game, similar to Unpacking but you have complete freedom, with mysterious puzzles to solve. I find the art really endearing. The game story itself is quite short - finished under 6 hours - but I still need to replay for all decorations to be unlocked. Recommended!

ドットが大変綺麗で、キャラもとてもかわいいゲームです。
（現時点で4時間ほどプレイ済）

インテリアゲームだと、有名な某お片付け内装ゲームも持っていますが、あちらは３D酔いしたのと工程の多さ、完成した依頼部屋を二度と見ることができないという点で家具を適当に置くようになってしまいました。
それに対してこちらのゲームは町の中にお部屋があるので、依頼を完了したあとももう一度見に行くことができますし、手直しすることもできるのでちゃんと作る気になれました。
また、家具の種類も大変多く、どれも細かく丁寧に描かれているので、きっとドット絵を描くのが好きな方が担当されているんだろうなぁと勝手に考えてほっこりしました。
あと、音楽も好きです。美しいし、ちょっぴり懐かしさを感じます。

注意点を上げるとしたら、このゲームはやりこみゲーではありません。
ステータスは数時間でレベルマックス、実績はちょっとしたことでどんどん解除されていきます。
家具もチケットを使って購入しますが、どんどんチケットをもらえるので、がんばって集めるという感じでもありません。
「ストーリーとインテリアをとにかく気軽に楽しんで！」という作者様のお気遣いを感じます。
あと日本語訳がちょっと？という時がありますが、まぁ多少は仕方ないかなという感じです。

個人的には某農場経営ゲーやシムズゲーで時間を溶かしてる人間なので、箸休め的なこういうゲームは全然ありだと思います。
ホラー要素もちょっぴりあり、キャラもかわいいし、こんなにもしっかり家具を作られているので、今後もDLCなど出してくれたらぜひ遊びたいと思います。
Great little game reminiscent of Unpacking, fun and offers hours of replayability and creativity.

Essa foi minha primeira experiência com um jogo desse gênero, e fiquei muito satisfeita! Mesmo sem ter muito conhecimento de inglês, achei o jogo bem intuitivo — ele dá as pistas certas sem entregar os segredos, o que torna a exploração mais interessante. Tive que voltar algumas vezes em certos pontos pra entender melhor o que fazer, mas isso fez parte da diversão. Em nenhum momento a jogabilidade me frustrou — pelo contrário, me manteve curiosa e envolvida o tempo todo. A ambientação é linda, com um clima fofo e sombrio na medida certa. Me entreteu do começo ao fim.

Depois da atualização mais recente, a experiência com a decoração melhorou muito. Agora está muito mais fácil localizar os itens, o que é um ponto super positivo pra quem gosta de personalizar o ambiente sem perder tempo procurando as coisas.

10時間ほど遊びました。
お片付けゲームの代表作 Unpacking とは異なり、このゲームはどちらかというと「部屋のコーディネート」が中心です。
進めていくと空っぽの部屋をいくつか貰えたり、ミッション形式でコーディネートを自由に楽しめます。

マイナス点を挙げるとすれば、全体的に説明が少ないことです。
メールで届くミッションは序盤で届かなくなり（今後追加されるかは不明）、その後は「何をすればいいのか分かりづらい」です。
街を歩き回れば様々なギミックや入れる家を見つけられます。
また、家具を購入できるお店はいくつかマップに散り散りにありますが、
地図を見ただけでは「店舗名」が書いてあるだけでどこで何が買えるのかの繋がりが分かりづらいです。
バグもまだありますが、開発側が報告を受けて少しずつ改善しているようです。

おすすめポイントとしては、まずドットイラストのクオリティが非常に高いことです。
街のあちこちに仕掛けがあり、家具にもギミックがあって、ドット絵好きにはたまらないかわいさです。
また「片付け」要素よりも「部屋のデザイン・コーディネート」を楽しみたい方に特におすすめできます。

ive been looking for a game like this for so long. tons of decor options, the ability to both freeball and follow a guide when decorating, cute sprites and awesome art, lots to explore (puzzles! and trash!!!), etc. etc. Might be one of my favorite games of the year so far. I'm addicted, I think.

An enthralling interactive decorating game with something strange going on in town...

what a gem! this game ticks all the boxes- cute graphics, interesting story, lots of hidden stuffs/achievements to discover, really great for players who like to sort things in specific manners, it brings you calm and joy. it's great that you can revisit the places that you have decorated and still interact with it if you'd like to. there are also modes that allow you to place whatever you like with some base items to get you started.

I really enjoyed this game. My only complaint was that I was able to complete the ending before finding all the items so not sure if that is a bug or if it was supposed to be that way. The game is super cute, the puzzles are fun and I wish it was longer!

Whisper of the House is a fun decorating/organizing simulator that adds a lot of whimsy into a relaxing treasure of a game. The furniture is SO cute and I like that most of the time you have plenty of choice in how you create the rooms. It encourages exploration/curiosity as well with plenty of achievements to work towards and fun puzzles throughout. I loved Unpacking and this satisfies that same part of my brain that yearns to organize! 

A few things though- the story line is extremely disjointed. There are envelopes of special moments but nothing that created an entire package if that makes sense. The translations are kinda loose, sometimes conversations are nonsensical. The UI can confusing at times as well. One of the game tips that showed on a loading screen was to hide the UI when you take photos. I hid the UI and then couldn't figure out how to get it back effectively soft locking me from progressing. Someone in the Discord was kind enough to point out that the ESC key brings the settings back up, but that was not intuitive for me at all. The UI hides itself in camera mode anyway lol
 
Despite these issues, I have really enjoyed my time with Whisper of the House because the game mechanics and overall pacing were relaxing and satisfying. I don't regret purchasing it, have faith that the developers will continue to improve!

This game has a variety of home decor items and it was relaxing to put together the different houses and shops. The spooky elements were cute and fun to find. It was shorter than I was expecting, but worth the price.
Great little game, super cute and cosy with a fun story line and some interesting little puzzles along the way. Recommended. Will likely play through again.
i liked that its a super cute game! very laid back and the story is cute too!
终于又有一款质量及格的装修收纳游戏，虽说家具种类不是很足、在仓库里胡乱分类不好找、有的没有四面立绘、任务有点少，但总的来说作为小品很好玩

If you're wondering if you should buy this game: Yes, you should!

Seriously. If you enjoy organizing and decorating, this game is for you. Plus, you can continue to endlessly decorate spaces (your own properties as well as themed showroom tasks) after the credits have rolled on the main story, which gives this game real lasting power over others in the genre.

Any future updates and/or DLC would be welcome, but merely icing on the cake as the game is worth every penny as it is currently.

Amazing! i finished the game over the course of 3 days because i couldn't stop playing it. i hope we get DLC's and or more quests.

Great little game. The overall look and feel is so cozy and quaint. Some of the furniture organisation, variety, colour schemes and scaling needs work, but I've squeezed many hours out of this game and I can't wait for the next update.

エンディングまでプレイしました。もっともっと遊びたいと思いました。DLCなどが出たら良いなと思っています。

住民の依頼を受けて、その人の家の片付け・家具の配置、整理をするのがメインです。
家には用意された家具や小物を、"いい具合"に置くのが良いみたいです。(洗面台には歯ブラシを置くのような感じ)
ストーリーでは用意された家具を色々考えつつ自分の好みに配置するのがとても楽しいです。
また、手持ちの家具や小物を依頼者の要望に合わせて自由に配置する任意のミッションもあります。
こちらのミッションの方は、自由に考える必要があるので、ストーリーとはまた違う脳を使う感じがあります。

ゲームの全体的な雰囲気はほのぼの・のんびり・少し不思議？という感じで、悪意のあるキャラクターや展開がないのでかなり癒されます。
時間経過の概念はありますが、経過によるデメリットは無いです。定刻にメールが来る仕組みですが、確認も好きなタイミングで大丈夫だと思います。
また、ドットで表現されていますが大きな建物や、水、光の表現などはとてもキレイです。
冲着画风和声音来的，音乐很贴场景，音效做的也很简洁明了，海边发呆的时候还可以ducking音乐只听环境声(〃'▽'〃)就是游戏体量和原价感觉性价比不高，希望后面还有更新

ハウスキーパー、というか引っ越し手伝い兼インテリアデザイナーをしながら、少し不思議な町で働くゲーム
BGMが非常によく、聞きながら室内コーディネートを考えるのが楽しい
インテリアゲームと考えると、家具のカテゴリ分けにテーマが含まれていない（中国系の家具だけみたい/スチール系の家具だけ見たいに対応していない）のがすこし面倒だった。探している最中にテーマから外れるけどこれいいかもなと意外な組み合わせに挑戦することが結果的に多くなったので、考えようにもよるかも。
ゲーム開始時に気になったところや、住民の中でこのひと（？）の依頼絶対あるでしょ！と思った部分がさらっと流されていたので、それについて触れられるようなDLCがあればうれしいな


以下トロコン関連の話
一部の実績は取り逃すと最初からやるしかないので、トロコンをしたい人はこまめなセーブをお勧めします。
家具や雑貨でインタラクトできるものを見つけたら何度もやってみるといいかも。あと電気をつけたり消したりしながら、ここには自然光が入るかどうかをみるのもいいかも。
Fun, laid back, and chill with cute item collection, creative decorating freedom and a light story to back it up. Interesting, short and well made. The pixel art is great.

遊戲玩法跟unpacking基本一樣，但多了非常非常多互動元素，而且不是箱子可以打開這種簡單的互動
而是有可能要透過將某些家具組合在一起才能推動隱藏劇情那種。

玩家扮演剛搬進小鎮的搬家工人，透過幫鎮上不同的居民搬家來認識更多人，進而得知這個小鎮不為人知的秘密...
看得出工作室對這款遊戲的物品文本下了不少功夫，擺放家具的同時也能讀一下物品的敘述來了解居民的人生，

玩法上也十分有趣，除了可以幫居民搬家、整理店鋪之外，玩家也有屬於自己的房間，可以透過認識更多居民的家

It's so beautiful and cosy, and I really enjoyed the storyline, but the game itself is broken. Without spoilers, a few of the critical quests make quite literally no sense (no guidance, journal entries or NPC hints). Hours of gameplay can be wasted due to opaque progression and terrible UX.

With that being said, my version of the game is bugged (I hate "cheating" but I was forced to check) as completing MULTIPLE specific quests does not trigger the necessary progression, or does not register as completed, which has ruined the experience. It is possible that the "impossible" quests / lack of guidance is also a bug. Maybe I just got unlucky as I would agree with the positive rating if the game worked. I've gotten a refund.

However, I feel that it is unacceptable for them to have sold this as a "finished" game when several elements are clearly half-baked and buggy. Others in online forums (Reddit etc.) have also reported this issue. I would avoid until the developers patch this, and provide proper guidance in the gameplay if that is not a bug. Overall, I am extremely irritated and disappointed.

Pros: beautiful pixel-style art and graphics, fun storyline.
Cons: game-breaking bugs, total lack of guidance in areas, and frustrating UX.

Update: I have changed my rating. The latest patch has fixed the bugs, though I stand by what I said about lack of guidance on critical quests. Overall, I enjoyed it.

This is nearly everything I've ever wanted in a decoration game. The core gameplay is similar to Unpacked. Your robot buddy gives you items, and every item is a surprise! [h1] [b] 爱，死亡与神秘人[/b][/h1]
[h2] 截止本评测发布时原价为54，首发折扣也是史低为[b]48.6[/b]，全成就时间大致为7小时左右 [/h2]
今年最期待的国产独立游戏，很早之前就在关注也玩了demo，非常喜欢像素画风，正式版也果断入手，没有让人失望，是十分好玩的小而美。我们将扮演家政工在神秘小镇中解决各式各样的委托，同时发现世界的真相。主题其实是温馨休闲的，恐怖元素更像解谜的引导，节奏自由没有强制你做任务，家具种类丰富可爱可以抽盲盒，还有中国风格的特色区域和让人会心一笑的特殊互动，我最喜欢花店和面包店，装饰的时候能感受到这些细碎的小东西和文本构成了每个人的生活，音效和音乐真的特别特别好，非常契合整体风格，放东西的音效很Q弾，晚上入睡之前可以玩这个（没有说无聊的意思），能让你很快的静下心，就是ASMR的感觉。虽然总体的主线流程不长，但是从地图上有很多规划好的地方，所以如果未来保持更新，丰富度还有很多可以扩展的空间，而且装修游戏不是说过完主线就不能玩了，能一直搭配家具来做自由委托，综合评价下来现在购买完全是值得的。
剧情方面为了不涉及剧透所以我设置了隐藏内容，但是可以很认真地说写的十分细腻感人，能够打动我，并且让人感觉到爱，这就是我体验过后的总结。
[hr][/hr
[spoiler] 露娜和闺蜜的友情，雪莉尔和男友的爱情，爱机斯坦和爷爷的亲情，甚至还有小鱼和幻想朋友，黑手和白老太太和猫，每段都写的特别好，既有平淡也有冒险，每个人物都有爱都是鲜活的，做白老太太的遗物整理真的有点泪目,一个人在临终时的东西说少不少，说多却也不多，如果没有人整理就会被销毁了吧，就好像连最后的存在也被抹除了，但是幸好我们还有爱，爱让人不会忘记和恐惧，有爱不死 ，我把她的东西都打包了没有丢掉，鲜活的花就像她还在，会有人睹物思人，和后面墓地的亡灵节布置委托配合的很好，特别是看过《寻梦环游记》就会感触更深。就像神秘人说的那样，“我”是奇迹，至少在这个世界我能够帮助他们整理秩序，有美好生活的能力。[/spoiler]
以上，感谢制作组的努力，也祝大家玩的愉快。

The game is super cute and very fun to play especially when you want to pass the time. I love how there is a mystery but also you get to decorate and design homes. The art is amazing and gives a warm feel. The music isn't loud but nothing headphones cant do. Finding the shops was kinda hard but that's what made it fun. I very much loved this game.

推荐购买
但评分最多只能给到7/10

+精致的像素动画，有趣的彩蛋设计
+大地图内容丰富，收集要素很多
-主线内容太少，需要更多主线关卡，通关后内容几乎为0

说实话一开始玩的非常开心，这款游戏的像素动画真的非常精致量大管饱，一直在佩服这么便宜能买到一款动画如此丰富，丰富到不要钱程度的游戏居然才这个价格。
装修的部分改掉了大多数像素风格整理游戏的痛点，能感受到作者对这类型游戏的热爱且玩的很多很知道怎么才能做的好玩。但很遗憾本游戏主线的体量却远远少于同类型游戏，导致还没爽多久游戏主线就完了，彻底没事干了。
而且主线之后基本就是抽家具解锁家具做做成就，我这个时长甚至是开了两个档做了两遍主线的，有个成就触发有点问题重打了一遍（海边小屋的二次装修任务结算有bug）。所以性价比是否及格还要画个问号，希望未来能通过持续更新或者dlc的模式添加更多的关卡或者说可游玩内容，游戏底子很好我觉得很有潜力，但目前这个感觉我更倾向于说这是一个只装了半瓶子的好酒，期待未来能有更好的展现。
提点意见：
1.引导可以做的更好，需要有个明确的指引，比如说通知栏一类的内容，或者给主角做个手机随时查看任务和已完成任务，随时查看地图和已收集内容进行整合。
2.需要标准答案功能，很多时候自己整理的不满意，在事后调整时希望有个参考，强迫症整理的不合预期时很需要这么个东西，可以说是“AI推荐整理”在玩家交房之后公布答案，一不影响玩家主动布置，二事后可以总结经验。
3.可以把样板房这个玩法拓展，不知道有没有玩过这代动森的dlc，将自己布置好且贴好标签的房间推荐给不同性格的NPC整取金钱并提高评价，这样开发难度低且可以算作长期游玩内容。
个人拙见，希望可以提供参考。
游戏很有潜力，希望越做越好
摆放自由性较高，也有按要求摆放的关卡，满足不同的喜好。而且可以装修自己的房子，有不同的户型，家具也很好获得。还有很多小彩蛋，不同交互点后续还会产生关联这点挺惊喜的，值得一玩。
好玩……！！！难度不高很轻松，有一丢丢细思极恐的感觉，很喜欢
An incredible charming game with decorating your own house, cute and cozy furniture, cozy soundtrack. I loved every second of this game! Very delightful game, hope they add more to it.

the achievements are relatively easy to find if you follow the slight riddle in their descriptions. the only cons I have are that the gameplay levels just suddenly end with no real indication + some of the ui/translations are a bit rough around the edges but nothing that really sticks out. really wish it leaned more into [spoiler]the slight "spooky" side it had going - primarily at the haunted tower and the hidden room! - as this would have been pretty unique in this type of game :D[/spoiler]

all in all, pretty cute! good to wait for a sale as it only takes around >8hrs to finish depending on how much you explore/[spoiler]notice the anomalies[/spoiler].

⭐ Whisper of the House – Cozy with a Hint of Mystery ⭐

Whisper of the House is a surprisingly relaxing and cozy experience with just the right touch of mystery. You play as a housekeeper who’s new in town, working for a company that helps residents move into their homes and gets local shops set up. Along the way, you’ll be cleaning, organizing, and fixing up the town—everything from tidying up trash to repairing objects that are mysteriously “glitched.”

What really stood out to me is how the game balances cozy, laid-back gameplay with a storyline that hints at something deeper. The town feels warm and inviting, but there’s also this subtle haunted vibe that makes you want to keep exploring and see what’s really going on behind the scenes.

It’s the kind of game you can unwind with—whether you’re completing small tasks, wandering the streets, or piecing together the story. If you enjoy cozy sims, light puzzle-solving, and a dash of supernatural mystery, this is a wonderful little gem worth picking up.

This game was great! A nice game with a lot of potential. I'd say a playthrough was probably 7-8 hours for me? The different puzzles were fun and I kept coming back excited to continue. Whisper in the House plays a bit to the organizing itch, but also to simple puzzle solving. I'm playing it again now to connect more of the story for myself. Well worth the purchase.

A nice quiet cozy game with an enjoyable soundtrack, WOFTH offers an enjoyable story line based around the core mechanic of decorating, sprinkled varying tasks to drive the story, and hidden anomalies/puzzles to solve, this game is short and sweet with an expected endgame/replay. While somewhat repetitive, there's promising room for updates, DLC/expansions, and improvement.

A few points of improvement
1) furniture rotation - many items are locked to only 2 positions (as noted above, limiting their aesthetic use)
2) better/more inclusive customization of furniture - very few offer the color change option
3) better/more wall, floor, and railing options (renovation)

In the future, it'd be nice to have the ability to chose house layouts or at least move stairs/lofts to create a better sandbox experience. Overall I give this game an 8/10 - it's just the beginning, and I hope to see more!

《呓语小镇》的核心玩法简单却令人上瘾。玩家扮演一名专业的整理师，来到一个充满个性居民的小镇，接受各种搬家、整理和打扫的委托。

游戏最出色的地方在于其对“整理”这一行为的深度挖掘。不同于简单的物品摆放，《呓语小镇》将整理升华为一门艺术，一种与人交流的方式。每个委托人的性格和需求都截然不同，玩家需要仔细观察对话线索，了解委托人的真实需求，才能做出最合适的整理方案。这种设计让简单的收纳工作充满了人情味和故事性。

游戏的视觉风格采用柔和的像素画风，色彩温暖而不刺眼，每个场景都像是一幅精美的插画。小镇居民设计各具特色却又统一在整体的美术风格中，每个角色都栩栩如生，令人忍不住想要了解更多他们的故事。

音效设计是《呓语小镇》的另一大亮点。轻柔的背景音乐仿佛微风拂过，整理物品时发出的满足感十足的音效，物品摆放到位时清脆的“咔哒”声，都经过精心设计，带给玩家舒适体验。游戏甚至考虑了不同材质物品移动时的音效差异，这种对细节的关注令人赞叹。

《呓语小镇》还巧妙地融入了一些轻量解谜元素。有时重要的物品会藏在意想不到的地方，需要玩家仔细观察环境；有时委托人会给出模糊的提示，需要玩家推理出他们真正的需求。这些设计为游戏增添了足够的挑战性，避免了玩法过于单一。

在快节奏的现代生活中，《呓语小镇》提供了一种难得的慢下来的体验。它没有紧张的时间限制，没有失败的惩罚，只有慢慢整理、精心布置的满足感。游戏传递的核心信息——通过整理外部环境来整理内心——对于被物质和信息过载困扰的现代人来说，具有意想不到的治愈效果。

总而言之，《呓语小镇》是一款难得的心灵疗愈之作。它将日常生活中的普通事务转化为充满魔力的体验，让玩家在整理虚拟空间的同时，也仿佛整理了自己的心情。如果你厌倦了打打杀杀，想要寻找一片宁静的虚拟天地，那么《呓语小镇》绝对是你的不二之选。在这里，每一次整理都是一次心灵spa，每一次委托完成都是一份温暖的成就。

打完结局感觉游戏的完成度有点又高又低的，本以为背后有一个特别大的秘密，最后掲示出来的结局还说得过去，但也会让人觉得开发组在剧情方面的尝试有点浅尝辄止。这也不算是缺点，如果刻意去做特别庞大复杂的剧情结果拖垮了开发或者让剧情又臭又长并不是一种好事，目前停留在每个故事都简单但温馨的程度其实不错，但如果后续开发dlc或者同类型作品/续作希望开发组能在这方面更进一步。
很多demo里的未开发区域似乎在正式版本里也没有过多拓展，不知道小镇的边界是为了后续开发预留还是单纯的空气墙？希望起码要做个dlc填充一下，目前确实可游玩的主线剧情不算很多，虽然因为物品密度高加上几乎每个物品都有相对应的说明，可能这方面的工作量比玩家实际上体验到的要多，所以我可以接受这个价格，但如果开发组能有后续的更新拓展显然会让游戏性价比方面的争议少很多。
游戏主要玩法应该是收纳+装修，个人感觉收纳是主线，装修算是自选的拓展玩法，显然主线对于游玩时间的支撑比较有限，但装修方面的问题确实是有些多，如果是专门冲着玩装修来的话，可能会觉得限制太多，可选项不够丰富。
开发者虽然做了物品分类但感觉分类做得很混乱，尤其是杂物和装饰两个大类，建议按照常见的装修摆放逻辑添加一些物品标签（比如书籍类物品就打上书籍tag，很多都只有书名，搜索的时候找不全；瓶瓶罐罐类的东西可以加上瓶子标签，调味料加上调味料标签这样）。大部分物品和家装都不能自选颜色，很多东西能不能叠放、并放的判定也比较抽象，也不能调整大小，自由度确实不高，只能说可以玩，但在装修类游戏里不算是很有竞争力。
我个人其实是比起装修更喜欢玩收纳的人，也就是更喜欢直接塞给我一堆东西让我摆放这种玩法，对我来说比给我一个空房间让我随便摆更好，目前游戏的设计上也是收纳比装修更好玩一些，真心希望多加一些收纳关卡，或者给玩家自由装修和收纳两种玩法的可选项（那些自由接取的任务，开发者可以做出对应的模板，将整套物品提供给玩家让玩家自由摆放）。我认为其实呓语小镇确实更适合重点做收纳方向，因为要在装修方面追赶其他装精装修的游戏比较难，但收纳方面就不需要在玩法上丰富那么多的内容，只需要按照目前的模式继续添加故事线、增加可供收纳的房屋即可。
以及，便利店的收纳，那几个不能移动的冰柜能不能设计成可移动的？在被遮挡的情况下很多东西放进去了很难拿出来，很多东西也放不进去，玩的时候真的有点急火攻心了。
虽然游戏的可探索点很多，但变化相对来说少了一些，这些应该依然是开发体量的问题，但还是希望开发者能在这方面多做一些努力。比如增加剧情人物对话内容，增加路边随机npc的对话内容，一些互动后会有反应的物品（比如博物馆门口的长颈鹿雕塑）如果后续没有其他反应，可以删掉互动选项？因为场景可互动物太多了，但变化不大，我垃圾桶就摸不过来了。地图里还有一些没有太多剧情的类似彩蛋的npc，如果能增加一些互动的话会更好，可以让整个小镇更有变化感。主线剧情人物之间也是很少有什么互动，很多地图完成后并没有npc在活动（比如便利店、面包店、酒吧根本没开门啊），就会让人觉得有点缺少生活感（当然可以用主线剧情来解释，但既然主角已经改变了这一切，希望还是有所不同）。黑手那条线感觉也是没有怎么铺开呢，有些可惜，甚至连本人都没有见到。如果去墓地的时候能见到黑手来献花就会觉得更有实感。
像现在这样除了偶尔会下雨并没有什么时间变化，是不是在游戏内能引入节庆系统？当然因为游戏时间过得太快，很容易不小心跳过节庆，所以也可以通过锁定或者强制进入或者延长节日周期这样的方式来规避这个问题，节庆主题可以用来做一些支线剧情将主线人物聚在一起，或者出一些节日主题的家装，很适合用来丰富内容。考虑到结局的剧情，也可以是在完成主线后，可以由主角来操控时间变化，主动进入节庆或者制造节庆

整理房间，想必是许多人都不乐意做的事情，把散落于房间的各种东西归类，然后摆放，是一件很麻烦的事情，不过强迫症例外。不过话说回来，现实中整理房间我不情愿，到了游戏里就不一样了，之前推出的整理游戏《unpacking》，就挺受欢迎的。

而《呓语小镇》与《unpacking》有些相似，是一款休闲的整理类游戏，这款游戏的部分玩法部分相同，在此基础上拓展了更多的玩法。游戏中，玩家将扮演一位来到小镇的家政师，会从小镇的居民那里接到委托，帮他们整理和装修。

游戏的美术非常不错，利用像素打造了一个极具生活气息的小镇，各种住房，便利店，医院，酒吧，乐器行，甚至坟墓都有。而且，小镇中的居民来来往往，构造出一幅和谐美丽的小镇生活画卷。

游戏的玩法非常简单，就是按照居民的要求，将他们的一些生活物件，整整齐齐的摆放好。要说简单，其实也没那么简单，有时候，需要摆放的东西，空间不够，需要摆到其他地方，就让人有点难受，直接全部重新摆放。有些则不是自由发挥，而是完完全全的按照顾客的指示，每一样放在哪都规划的好好的，只需要从箱子中取出摆好就OK了。还有一类更是考验玩家的装修水平，直接依照玩家现有的各种家具来进行装修，像我这种没啥想象力和创造力的装修出来和大佬们差别就很大了。

小镇之中存在着非常多的超自然现象，你可以看到在篮球场不断弹跳的篮球，还有各位居民家中各种奇异的物件，每当你解决掉一样奇异物件，博物馆上的数字减少一样的时候，就让人感到小镇的不简单。除了那些奇异的物件外，小镇中可以交互的东西也是非常的多，每次前往任务地点的途中，总要这点一下，那点一下。

同时，游戏采用了大量的环境叙事技法，好几个任务背后，都可以通过房间里本来就有的物品，和需要摆放的物品，推断出一个小故事，比如因为研究炼金术而消失的炼金术师和等待他多年的爱人，还有自己幻想出的童年玩伴等等。

《呓语小镇》就是这么一款轻松休闲的游戏，美术也很好，玩起来十分的惬意。

大概八个小时左右就通关了，有点解密在里面，不难，还是很好玩的，而且解密出来的剧情都挺有趣。
通关了之后又花两个小时左右做了一下全成就，全成就完了又去搞全图鉴，不过还是没全图鉴，也不知道剩下的一点去哪搞了，不过好在也就几件没管了。
目前是在做任务板子的任务，搞钱争取给四个房子都重装一下。
玩下来总体还是很开心的，我最爱做的就是那个酒吧和琴行了一个个摆上去好爽（谁懂），瓶瓶罐罐的声音放下去很爽，感觉像是再看那种收纳整理的asmr，包括bgm都很优秀，玩的时候很放松。
不过也有点小问题在里面，第一个就是分类，说实话有点一坨。我根本找不到我想要的东西，而且还不好搜，比如我想要个淋浴头，他有叫淋浴的有叫花洒的，所以有时候可能你搜了也找不到全部这类物品，是后来玩熟了，再加上他这个家具不算多，硬是记下来了，他这个除了横竖有那种分类再就是有个小箭头里面写的地面类，壁挂类什么什么的，我说实话你不如把这个拿出来放在竖排然后横排直接做客厅，浴室，厨房，水吧，琴行这种分类，而且有些一套的东西他不挨着，比如厨房的橱柜，我一般都是搜关键字，要不然你哪怕是用他自己的分类筛选出来也不挨着，有点麻烦。
第二个就是家具比较少，有时候真搭不出来想要的风格，而且有的家具有四个面有的没有，有的能调色有的不能调，你这仨问题但凡解决一个都可以了。
第三个问题是买东西和钱的问题，确实如果你还没过完剧情，他给的奖励还算丰厚，但是这些钱大多都抽家具的，后期其实能留下来的钱不算太多，而且自己装自己的房子这些家具都要自己出钱，自己去买，哪怕有个大商场能买到几乎所有东西也很麻烦，如果你怕折腾，那肯定就要买的比较多，但是买的多了那就没钱了，任务板的任务做一个才给100-200，我真的不够用，这个任务版我也希望能改一下，你至少改成家具放的多少或者家具覆盖面积来计算这个钱，我真的希望我自己装修出来的小房间都漂漂亮亮的，所以哪怕是乱放几个家具就能拿到这个钱我也都有好好的装修，但是累死累活装出来一个房间才一百多块钱太少了，真的不够我装修我自己的房子。
我玩下来只有这三点是我实在难受的，其他的NPC太扁平，剧情比较少等等问题对我来说反而是次要的，这些东西改了就是锦上添花，希望能好好的打磨，真的很喜欢。
